package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import java.util.EnumMap;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/** Aggregate stats for one `generate` run, printed as the end-of-run summary. */
public final class GenerateResult {

    public final Map<SizeTier, Integer> countPerTier = new EnumMap<>(SizeTier.class);
    /** Deliberately-invalid files written by error injection (A6), by error type -- separate
     * from {@link #invalidCount}, which means "failed validation after 5 retries despite trying
     * to be valid" and is always 0 when error injection isn't in use. */
    public final Map<String, Integer> errorCountByType = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    public int validCount;
    public int invalidCount;
    public long totalBytes;
    public long minBytes = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    public long maxBytes = 0;
    public long elapsedMillis;
    public int totalRequested;

    public GenerateResult() {
        for (SizeTier tier : SizeTier.values()) {
            countPerTier.put(tier, 0);
        }
    }

    public double xmlsPerSecond() {
        if (elapsedMillis <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        return (validCount + invalidCount) / (elapsedMillis / 1000.0);
    }

    public int writtenCount() {
        return validCount + errorCountByType.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
    }

    public double avgBytes() {
        return writtenCount() == 0 ? 0 : (double) totalBytes / writtenCount();
    }

    public void noteFileSize(long bytes) {
        totalBytes += bytes;
        minBytes = Math.min(minBytes, bytes);
        maxBytes = Math.max(maxBytes, bytes);
    }

    public void print(java.io.PrintStream out) {
        out.println("  small=" + countPerTier.get(SizeTier.SMALL)
                + " medium=" + countPerTier.get(SizeTier.MEDIUM)
                + " large=" + countPerTier.get(SizeTier.LARGE));
        out.println("  valid=" + validCount + " invalid=" + invalidCount);
        if (!errorCountByType.isEmpty()) {
            out.println("  deliberately-invalid (error injection) by type: " + errorCountByType);
        }
        out.printf("  total size on disk: %.2f MB%n", totalBytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
        if (writtenCount() > 0) {
            out.printf("  size per file: min=%.2f KB avg=%.2f KB max=%.2f KB%n",
                    minBytes / 1024.0, avgBytes() / 1024.0, maxBytes / 1024.0);
        }
        out.printf("  time: %.2f s  (%.1f XMLs/sec)%n", elapsedMillis / 1000.0, xmlsPerSecond());
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import javax.xml.namespace.NamespaceContext;
import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;

/**
 * Wraps a StAX writer to add a newline and indentation before each structural (element) start/end
 * tag, while leaving a leaf element's own text content exactly as written -- {@code <tag>value</tag>}
 * stays on one line, with nothing inserted inside it. Since XML Schema element-only content models
 * always treat inter-element whitespace as ignorable, this is purely cosmetic: it never changes a
 * value that gets validated or compared.
 */
final class IndentingXmlStreamWriter implements XMLStreamWriter {

    private static final String INDENT_UNIT = "  ";

    private final XMLStreamWriter out;
    private final Deque<Boolean> hasChildElement = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private int depth = 0;

    IndentingXmlStreamWriter(XMLStreamWriter out) {
        this.out = out;
    }

    private void markParentHasChild() {
        if (!hasChildElement.isEmpty()) {
            hasChildElement.pop();
            hasChildElement.push(true);
        }
    }

    private void newLine() throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeCharacters("\n" + INDENT_UNIT.repeat(depth));
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartElement(String localName) throws XMLStreamException {
        markParentHasChild();
        newLine();
        out.writeStartElement(localName);
        hasChildElement.push(false);
        depth++;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartElement(String namespaceURI, String localName) throws XMLStreamException {
        markParentHasChild();
        newLine();
        out.writeStartElement(namespaceURI, localName);
        hasChildElement.push(false);
        depth++;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartElement(String prefix, String localName, String namespaceURI) throws XMLStreamException {
        markParentHasChild();
        newLine();
        out.writeStartElement(prefix, localName, namespaceURI);
        hasChildElement.push(false);
        depth++;
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEmptyElement(String namespaceURI, String localName) throws XMLStreamException {
        markParentHasChild();
        newLine();
        out.writeEmptyElement(namespaceURI, localName);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEmptyElement(String prefix, String localName, String namespaceURI) throws XMLStreamException {
        markParentHasChild();
        newLine();
        out.writeEmptyElement(prefix, localName, namespaceURI);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEmptyElement(String localName) throws XMLStreamException {
        markParentHasChild();
        newLine();
        out.writeEmptyElement(localName);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEndElement() throws XMLStreamException {
        depth--;
        boolean hadChild = hasChildElement.pop();
        if (hadChild) {
            newLine();
        }
        out.writeEndElement();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEndDocument() throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeEndDocument();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() throws XMLStreamException {
        out.close();
    }

    @Override
    public void flush() throws XMLStreamException {
        out.flush();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeAttribute(String localName, String value) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeAttribute(localName, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeAttribute(String prefix, String namespaceURI, String localName, String value) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeAttribute(prefix, namespaceURI, localName, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeAttribute(String namespaceURI, String localName, String value) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeAttribute(namespaceURI, localName, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeNamespace(String prefix, String namespaceURI) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeNamespace(prefix, namespaceURI);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeDefaultNamespace(String namespaceURI) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeDefaultNamespace(namespaceURI);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeComment(String data) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeComment(data);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeProcessingInstruction(String target) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeProcessingInstruction(target);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeProcessingInstruction(String target, String data) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeProcessingInstruction(target, data);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeCData(String data) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeCData(data);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeDTD(String dtd) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeDTD(dtd);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeEntityRef(String name) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeEntityRef(name);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartDocument() throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeStartDocument();
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartDocument(String version) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeStartDocument(version);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeStartDocument(String encoding, String version) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeStartDocument(encoding, version);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeCharacters(String text) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeCharacters(text);
    }

    @Override
    public void writeCharacters(char[] text, int start, int len) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.writeCharacters(text, start, len);
    }

    @Override
    public String getPrefix(String uri) throws XMLStreamException {
        return out.getPrefix(uri);
    }

    @Override
    public void setPrefix(String prefix, String uri) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.setPrefix(prefix, uri);
    }

    @Override
    public void setDefaultNamespace(String uri) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.setDefaultNamespace(uri);

    @Override
    public void setNamespaceContext(NamespaceContext context) throws XMLStreamException {
        out.setNamespaceContext(context);
    }

    @Override
    public NamespaceContext getNamespaceContext() {
        return out.getNamespaceContext();
    }

    @Override
    public Object getProperty(String name) throws IllegalArgumentException {
        return out.getProperty(name);

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/generate/NameValueProfile.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import org.yaml.snakeyaml.Yaml;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Per-field overrides to the generator's name-based value rules, loaded from a small YAML file:
 * <pre>
 * rules:
 *   PlcAndNm: xpath
 * </pre>
 * A field matched here skips {@link ValueGenerator}'s ordinary name-sniffing (e.g. "contains nm"
 * -> a person's name) in favor of the named rule. Unmatched fields behave exactly as before.
 */
final class NameValueProfile {

    enum Rule {
        /** A path-like string pointing at another element of the same message, e.g.
         * "/Document/CorpActnGnlInf" -- used for fields like PlcAndNm that name a *place in the
         * message*, not a person or location name despite what "Nm" suggests. */
        ELEMENT_PATH,
        DEFAULT
    }

    private final Map<String, Rule> rules;

    private NameValueProfile(Map<String, Rule> rules) {
        this.rules = rules;
    }

    /** PlcAndNm -> element-path is the one override every seev/supl message needs, regardless of
     * whether a custom profile is supplied, since "PlcAndNm" containing "Nm" is otherwise
     * indistinguishable from a true person/place name field to the ordinary name-sniffing rules. */
    static NameValueProfile defaultProfile() {
        Map<String, Rule> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put("PlcAndNm", Rule.ELEMENT_PATH);
        return new NameValueProfile(m);
    }

    static NameValueProfile load(Path yamlFile) throws IOException {
        Map<String, Rule> m = new HashMap<>(defaultProfile().rules);
        Yaml yaml = new Yaml();
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(yamlFile)) {
            Object parsed = yaml.load(in);
            if (parsed instanceof Map<?, ?> doc && doc.get("rules") instanceof Map<?, ?> rulesMap) {
                for (var entry : rulesMap.entrySet()) {
                    m.put(String.valueOf(entry.getKey()), parseRule(String.valueOf(entry.getValue())));
                }
            }
        }
        return new NameValueProfile(m);
    }

    private static Rule parseRule(String value) {
        return "xpath".equalsIgnoreCase(value) || "element-path".equalsIgnoreCase(value)
                ? Rule.ELEMENT_PATH : Rule.DEFAULT;
    }

    Rule ruleFor(String elementLocalName) {
        return rules.getOrDefault(elementLocalName, Rule.DEFAULT);
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import java.io.IOException;

/**
 * Where a generated file's content goes -- a folder on disk, a ZIP archive, or an arbitrary
 * caller-supplied stream (A10). {@link GenerateCommand} writes through this interface uniformly;
 * validation uses {@link com.project.toolkit.validate.XsdValidatorCache#validateString} on the
 * in-memory content rather than reading back whatever {@link #write} did, so no implementation
 * needs to support being read from.
 */
interface OutputTarget extends AutoCloseable {

    void write(String fileName, String content) throws IOException;

    @Override
    void close() throws IOException;
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * The flattened result of walking an XSD simple type's restriction chain: the ultimate
 * built-in base type plus every facet collected along the way (most specific wins).
 */
final class ResolvedSimpleType {

    QName primitive = new QName("http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema", "string");
    List<String> enumerationValues = new ArrayList<>();
    String pattern;
    Integer minLength;
    Integer maxLength;
    Integer length;
    Integer totalDigits;
    Integer fractionDigits;
    String minInclusive;
    String maxInclusive;
    String minExclusive;
    String maxExclusive;

    ResolvedSimpleType copy() {
        ResolvedSimpleType c = new ResolvedSimpleType();
        c.primitive = this.primitive;
        c.enumerationValues = new ArrayList<>(this.enumerationValues);
        c.pattern = this.pattern;
        c.minLength = this.minLength;
        c.maxLength = this.maxLength;
        c.length = this.length;
        c.totalDigits = this.totalDigits;
        c.fractionDigits = this.fractionDigits;
        c.minInclusive = this.minInclusive;
        c.maxInclusive = this.maxInclusive;
        c.minExclusive = this.minExclusive;
        c.maxExclusive = this.maxExclusive;
        return c;
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.*;

import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Collects the local names of every element reachable from the root, for building plausible
 * "path to an element of the parent message" values (see {@link NameValueProfile}) -- read-only,
 * walked once per run, independent of {@link XmlInstanceGenerator}'s writing walk.
 */
final class SchemaElementNames {

    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 6;

    private SchemaElementNames() {
    }

    static List<String> collect(SchemaIndex index) {
        Set<String> names = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        Set<QName> visitedTypes = new HashSet<>();
        collectFromElement(index, index.rootElement, names, visitedTypes, 0);
        return new ArrayList<>(names);
    }

    private static void collectFromElement(SchemaIndex index, XmlSchemaElement element, Set<String> names,
                                             Set<QName> visitedTypes, int depth) {
        names.add(element.getName());
        if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) {
            return;
        }
        XmlSchemaType type = resolveType(index, element);
        if (!(type instanceof XmlSchemaComplexType complexType)) {
            return;
        }
        QName typeName = element.getSchemaTypeName();
        if (typeName != null && !visitedTypes.add(typeName)) {
            return;
        }
        if (complexType.getParticle() != null) {
            collectFromParticle(index, complexType.getParticle(), names, visitedTypes, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    private static XmlSchemaType resolveType(SchemaIndex index, XmlSchemaElement element) {
        if (element.getSchemaTypeName() != null) {
            XmlSchemaType t = index.collection.getTypeByQName(element.getSchemaTypeName());
            if (t != null) {
                return t;
            }
        }
        return element.getSchemaType();
    }

    private static void collectFromParticle(SchemaIndex index, XmlSchemaParticle particle, Set<String> names,
                                              Set<QName> visitedTypes, int depth) {
        if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaSequence seq) {
            for (XmlSchemaSequenceMember m : seq.getItems()) {
                collectFromMember(index, m, names, visitedTypes, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaChoice choice) {
            for (Object m : choice.getItems()) {
                collectFromMember(index, m, names, visitedTypes, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaAll all) {
            for (XmlSchemaAllMember m : all.getItems()) {
                collectFromMember(index, m, names, visitedTypes, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaGroupRef groupRef && groupRef.getParticle() != null) {
            collectFromParticle(index, groupRef.getParticle(), names, visitedTypes, depth);
        }
    }

    private static void collectFromMember(SchemaIndex index, Object member, Set<String> names,
                                           Set<QName> visitedTypes, int depth) {
        if (member instanceof XmlSchemaElement el) {
            collectFromElement(index, el, names, visitedTypes, depth);
        } else if (member instanceof XmlSchemaParticle p) {
            collectFromParticle(index, p, names, visitedTypes, depth);
        }
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/generate/SchemaIndex.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.XmlSchema;
import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.XmlSchemaCollection;
import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.XmlSchemaElement;

import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;

/** Loads one XSD -- including whatever it pulls in via xs:import/xs:include, resolved relative
 * to the XSD's own folder -- and finds its single top-level element. */
final class SchemaIndex {

    final XmlSchemaCollection collection;
    final XmlSchema schema;
    final XmlSchemaElement rootElement;
    private java.util.List<String> elementNamesCache;

    SchemaIndex(Path xsdPath) {
        this.collection = new XmlSchemaCollection();
        // Without a systemId, a relative xs:import/xs:include schemaLocation resolves against
        // the JVM's working directory instead of the XSD's own folder -- wrong file (or none
        // found) for any multi-file schema. The absolute file URI fixes that.
        try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(xsdPath.toFile())) {
            org.xml.sax.InputSource source = new org.xml.sax.InputSource(in);
            source.setSystemId(xsdPath.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toUri().toString());
            this.schema = collection.read(source);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Could not parse XSD: " + xsdPath + " -- " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
        this.rootElement = findRootElement(xsdPath);
    }

    private XmlSchemaElement findRootElement(Path xsdPath) {
        Map<javax.xml.namespace.QName, XmlSchemaElement> elements = schema.getElements();
        if (elements.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("XSD has no top-level element: " + xsdPath);
        }
        for (XmlSchemaElement el : elements.values()) {
            if ("Document".equals(el.getName())) {
                return el;
            }
        }
        return elements.values().iterator().next();
    }

    /** Every element local name reachable from the root -- computed once, lazily, since it's the
     * same for every file/trial in a run and only needed when a name-value profile rule asks
     * for a path into the message (see {@link NameValueProfile.Rule#ELEMENT_PATH}). */
    java.util.List<String> allElementNames() {
        if (elementNamesCache == null) {
            elementNamesCache = SchemaElementNames.collect(this);
        }
        return elementNamesCache;
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import java.nio.file.Path;

/** Public, read-only summary of one XSD's identity -- for callers outside this package (the API
 * module's schema registry) that just need to know what a schema is, not generate from it. */
public final class SchemaInfo {

    public final String rootElementName;
    public final String namespace;

    private SchemaInfo(String rootElementName, String namespace) {
        this.rootElementName = rootElementName;
        this.namespace = namespace;
    }

    public static SchemaInfo read(Path xsd) {
        SchemaIndex index = new SchemaIndex(xsd);
        String ns = index.schema.getTargetNamespace();
        return new SchemaInfo(index.rootElement.getName(), ns == null ? "" : ns);
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/generate/SchemaScanner.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.*;
import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.constants.Constants;

import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Read-only walk of an XSD's element tree (mirrors {@link SchemaElementNames}'s traversal, but
 * collecting facet/structure counts instead of names) -- the basis for A8's schema-scan output
 * and for A6's "only offer error types this XSD actually supports".
 */
public final class SchemaScanner {

    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 30;
    private static final Set<String> NON_STRING_PRIMITIVES = Set.of(
            "integer", "int", "long", "short", "nonNegativeInteger", "positiveInteger",
            "decimal", "date", "dateTime", "boolean", "gYear", "gYearMonth");
    private static final Set<String> DATE_LIKE_PRIMITIVES = Set.of("date", "dateTime", "gYear", "gYearMonth");

    private SchemaScanner() {
    }

    public static SchemaScanResult scan(SchemaIndex index) {
        SchemaScanResult r = new SchemaScanResult();
        SimpleTypeResolver resolver = new SimpleTypeResolver(index.collection);
        walkElement(index, index.rootElement, resolver, r, new HashSet<>(), 0, true);

        r.possibleLevels.add(1);
        r.possibleLevels.add(2);
        r.possibleLevels.add(3);

        r.possibleErrorTypes.add("malformed-xml");
        r.possibleErrorTypes.add("invalid-characters");
        r.possibleErrorTypes.add("wrong-datatype");
        // Both always apply to any complex-typed document: a foreign element is always
        // "invalid content", and there's always at least one non-root element whose namespace
        // can be swapped out.
        r.possibleErrorTypes.add("unexpected-element");
        if (r.requiredCount > 0 || r.optionalCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("invalid-namespace");
        }
        if (r.requiredCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("missing-required");
        }
        if (r.enumerationCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("invalid-code");
        }
        if (r.patternCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("pattern-break");
        }
        if (r.maxLengthCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("too-long");
        }
        if (r.finiteRepeatCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("too-many-repeats");
        }
        if (r.dateTypeCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("invalid-date");
        }
        if (r.requiredAttributeCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("missing-attribute");
        }
        if (r.corruptibleAttributeCount > 0) {
            r.possibleErrorTypes.add("invalid-attribute-value");
        }
        return r;
    }

    private static void walkElement(SchemaIndex index, XmlSchemaElement element, SimpleTypeResolver resolver,
                                      SchemaScanResult r, Set<QName> visitedTypes, int depth, boolean isRoot) {
        r.maxDepth = Math.max(r.maxDepth, depth);
        if (!isRoot) {
            if (element.getMinOccurs() >= 1) {
                r.requiredCount++;
            } else {
                r.optionalCount++;
            }
            long max = element.getMaxOccurs();
            if (max > 1) {
                r.repeatingCount++;
                if (max != Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                    r.finiteRepeatCount++;
                }
            }
        }
        if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) {
            return;
        }

        QName namedType = element.getSchemaTypeName();
        if (namedType != null && Constants.URI_2001_SCHEMA_XSD.equals(namedType.getNamespaceURI())) {
            if (DATE_LIKE_PRIMITIVES.contains(namedType.getLocalPart())) {
                r.dateTypeCount++;
            }
            return; // built-in primitive leaf, nothing further to scan
        }

        XmlSchemaType type = resolveType(index, element);
        if (type instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleType simpleType) {
            noteFacets(resolver, namedType != null ? namedType : simpleType.getQName(), r);
            return;
        }
        if (!(type instanceof XmlSchemaComplexType complexType)) {
            return;
        }
        if (namedType != null && !visitedTypes.add(namedType)) {
            return;
        }

        if (complexType.getContentModel() instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleContent simpleContent
                && simpleContent.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleContentExtension extension) {
            walkAttributes(resolver, extension.getAttributes(), r);
            noteFacets(resolver, extension.getBaseTypeName(), r);
            return;
        }
        walkAttributes(resolver, complexType.getAttributes(), r);
        if (complexType.getParticle() != null) {
            walkParticle(index, complexType.getParticle(), resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    private static void walkAttributes(SimpleTypeResolver resolver, List<XmlSchemaAttributeOrGroupRef> attributes, SchemaScanResult r) {
        if (attributes == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (XmlSchemaAttributeOrGroupRef item : attributes) {
            if (!(item instanceof XmlSchemaAttribute attr)) {
                continue;
            }
            r.attributeCount++;
            if (attr.getUse() == XmlSchemaUse.REQUIRED) {
                r.requiredAttributeCount++;
            }
            if (attr.getSchemaTypeName() != null) {
                ResolvedSimpleType resolved = resolver.resolve(attr.getSchemaTypeName());
                if (!resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty() || resolved.pattern != null || resolved.maxLength != null
                        || (resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty() && NON_STRING_PRIMITIVES.contains(resolved.primitive.getLocalPart()))) {
                    r.corruptibleAttributeCount++;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void noteFacets(SimpleTypeResolver resolver, QName typeName, SchemaScanResult r) {
        ResolvedSimpleType resolved = resolver.resolve(typeName);
        if (!resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty()) {
            r.enumerationCount++;
        }
        if (resolved.pattern != null) {
            r.patternCount++;
        }
        if (resolved.maxLength != null) {
            r.maxLengthCount++;
        }
        if (DATE_LIKE_PRIMITIVES.contains(resolved.primitive.getLocalPart())) {
            r.dateTypeCount++;
        }
    }

    private static XmlSchemaType resolveType(SchemaIndex index, XmlSchemaElement element) {
        if (element.getSchemaTypeName() != null) {
            XmlSchemaType t = index.collection.getTypeByQName(element.getSchemaTypeName());
            if (t != null) {
                return t;
            }
        }
        return element.getSchemaType();
    }

    private static void walkParticle(SchemaIndex index, XmlSchemaParticle particle, SimpleTypeResolver resolver,
                                      SchemaScanResult r, Set<QName> visitedTypes, int depth) {
        if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaSequence seq) {
            for (XmlSchemaSequenceMember m : seq.getItems()) {
                walkMember(index, m, resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaChoice choice) {
            r.choiceCount++;
            for (Object m : choice.getItems()) {
                walkMember(index, m, resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaAll all) {
            for (XmlSchemaAllMember m : all.getItems()) {
                walkMember(index, m, resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaGroupRef groupRef && groupRef.getParticle() != null) {
            walkParticle(index, groupRef.getParticle(), resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth);
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaAny) {
            r.anySlotCount++;
        }
    }

    private static void walkMember(SchemaIndex index, Object member, SimpleTypeResolver resolver,
                                    SchemaScanResult r, Set<QName> visitedTypes, int depth) {
        if (member instanceof XmlSchemaElement el) {
            walkElement(index, el, resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth, false);
        } else if (member instanceof XmlSchemaParticle p) {
            walkParticle(index, p, resolver, r, visitedTypes, depth);
        }
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeSet;

/** Counts of what a given XSD actually contains, and therefore which content levels and
 * error-injection types are meaningful for it (see {@link SchemaScanner}). */
public final class SchemaScanResult {
    public int requiredCount;
    public int optionalCount;
    public int repeatingCount;
    public int finiteRepeatCount;
    public int choiceCount;
    public int enumerationCount;
    public int patternCount;
    public int maxLengthCount;
    public int anySlotCount;
    public int maxDepth;
    public int dateTypeCount;
    public int attributeCount;
    public int requiredAttributeCount;
    public int corruptibleAttributeCount;
    public final Set<Integer> possibleLevels = new TreeSet<>();
    public final Set<String> possibleErrorTypes = new TreeSet<>();

    public void print(java.io.PrintStream out) {
        out.println("  required=" + requiredCount + " optional=" + optionalCount
                + " repeating=" + repeatingCount + " (finite maxOccurs>1: " + finiteRepeatCount + ")");
        out.println("  choices=" + choiceCount + " enumerations=" + enumerationCount
                + " patterns=" + patternCount + " maxLength facets=" + maxLengthCount + " xs:any slots=" + anySlotCount);
        out.println("  max depth=" + maxDepth);
        out.println("  date-like fields=" + dateTypeCount + " attributes=" + attributeCount
                + " (required: " + requiredAttributeCount + ", corruptible: " + corruptibleAttributeCount + ")");
        out.println("  possible levels=" + possibleLevels);
        out.println("  possible error types=" + possibleErrorTypes);
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/generate/SimpleTypeResolver.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.*;
import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.constants.Constants;

import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Walks an XSD simple type's restriction chain up to its built-in base, merging facets
 * (enumeration/pattern/length/digits/min-max) as it goes. Child facets win over inherited ones,
 * matching how XSD restriction narrows a type.
 */
final class SimpleTypeResolver {

    private final XmlSchemaCollection collection;
    private final Map<QName, ResolvedSimpleType> cache = new HashMap<>();

    SimpleTypeResolver(XmlSchemaCollection collection) {
        this.collection = collection;
    }

    ResolvedSimpleType resolve(QName typeName) {
        return resolve(typeName, new HashSet<>());
    }

    private ResolvedSimpleType resolve(QName typeName, Set<QName> seen) {
        if (typeName == null) {
            return new ResolvedSimpleType();
        }
        ResolvedSimpleType cached = cache.get(typeName);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached.copy();
        }
        if (Constants.URI_2001_SCHEMA_XSD.equals(typeName.getNamespaceURI())) {
            ResolvedSimpleType primitive = new ResolvedSimpleType();
            primitive.primitive = typeName;
            cache.put(typeName, primitive);
            return primitive.copy();
        }
        if (!seen.add(typeName)) {
            // Cyclic restriction chain (shouldn't happen in valid XSD); stop at string.
            return new ResolvedSimpleType();
        }

        XmlSchemaType type = collection.getTypeByQName(typeName);
        ResolvedSimpleType result;
        if (type instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleType simpleType
                && simpleType.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleTypeRestriction restriction) {
            QName baseName = restriction.getBaseTypeName();
            ResolvedSimpleType base = resolve(baseName, seen);
            result = base.copy();
            applyFacets(result, restriction.getFacets());
        } else {
            result = new ResolvedSimpleType();
        }

        cache.put(typeName, result);
        return result.copy();
    }

    private void applyFacets(ResolvedSimpleType target, List<XmlSchemaFacet> facets) {
        if (facets == null) {
            return;
        }
        boolean enumerationSeenHere = false;
        for (XmlSchemaFacet obj : facets) {
            if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaEnumerationFacet f) {
                if (!enumerationSeenHere) {
                    target.enumerationValues.clear();
                    enumerationSeenHere = true;
                }
                target.enumerationValues.add(String.valueOf(f.getValue()));
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaPatternFacet f) {
                target.pattern = String.valueOf(f.getValue());
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaMinLengthFacet f) {
                target.minLength = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(f.getValue()));
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaMaxLengthFacet f) {
                target.maxLength = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(f.getValue()));
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaLengthFacet f) {
                target.length = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(f.getValue()));
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaTotalDigitsFacet f) {
                target.totalDigits = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(f.getValue()));
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaFractionDigitsFacet f) {
                target.fractionDigits = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(f.getValue()));
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaMinInclusiveFacet f) {
                target.minInclusive = String.valueOf(f.getValue());
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaMaxInclusiveFacet f) {
                target.maxInclusive = String.valueOf(f.getValue());
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaMinExclusiveFacet f) {
                target.minExclusive = String.valueOf(f.getValue());
            } else if (obj instanceof XmlSchemaMaxExclusiveFacet f) {
                target.maxExclusive = String.valueOf(f.getValue());
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.generate;

/**
 * The three output size tiers. {@code repeatBoost} controls how many extra copies of a
 * maxOccurs&gt;1 element get written; it is damped per nesting level so repeats inside
 * repeats don't explode combinatorially.
 */
public enum SizeTier {
    SMALL(2_000, 1),
    MEDIUM(50_000, 3),
    LARGE(1_000_000, 6);

    final long targetBytes;
    final int initialRepeatFactor;

    SizeTier(long targetBytes, int initialRepeatFactor) {
        this.targetBytes = targetBytes;
        this.initialRepeatFactor = initialRepeatFactor;
    }

    public String label() {
        return name().toLowerCase();
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/generate/ValueGenerator.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Produces realistic leaf text values. Prefers XSD facets (enumeration/pattern) when present,
 * otherwise looks at the element's local name to pick a plausible value (amount, currency,
 * date, name, etc.), and falls back to a type-appropriate generic value.
 */
final class ValueGenerator {

    // A fixed anchor rather than LocalDate.now(): dates must be a pure function of the seed so
    // "--seed N" reproduces byte-identical output regardless of when the command actually runs.
    private static final LocalDate RECENT_ANCHOR = LocalDate.of(2026, 1, 1);

    /** RgxGen's default unbounded-quantifier repeat count is 100, which blows up badly on a
     * pattern with NESTED unbounded quantifiers (several real facets in these XSDs look like
     * {@code (X(X*(/X)?)*)}, where two nested {@code *} compound to roughly 100x100 characters)
     * -- confirmed empirically to produce multi-KB values against a 16-character maxLength.
     * A small bound here (matching the old hand-rolled sampler's 0-5/1-5 ranges) keeps generated
     * values close enough to typical facet lengths that {@link #sampleWithinLength} usually
     * finds one that fits on retry, without special-casing nesting depth. */
    private static final com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.config.RgxGenProperties PATTERN_PROPERTIES = boundedPatternProperties();

    private static com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.config.RgxGenProperties boundedPatternProperties() {
        var props = new com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.config.RgxGenProperties();
        com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.config.RgxGenOption.INFINITE_PATTERN_REPETITION.setInProperties(props, 3);
        return props;
    }

    private static final String[] CURRENCIES = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP", "JPY", "CHF", "INR", "AUD", "CAD", "SGD", "HKD"};
    private static final String[] COUNTRIES = {"US", "GB", "DE", "FR", "JP", "IN", "AU", "CA", "SG", "HK", "NL", "CH"};
    private static final String[] CITIES = {"New York", "London", "Frankfurt", "Paris", "Tokyo", "Mumbai", "Sydney", "Toronto", "Singapore", "Zurich"};
    private static final String[] GIVEN_NAMES = {"James", "Mary", "Robert", "Patricia", "John", "Linda", "Michael", "Elizabeth", "David", "Susan"};
    private static final String[] SURNAMES = {"Smith", "Johnson", "Williams", "Brown", "Jones", "Garcia", "Miller", "Davis", "Rodriguez", "Martinez"};

    private final Random rnd;
    private final Map<String, com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.RgxGen> patternCache = new java.util.HashMap<>();
    private final NameValueProfile profile;
    private final List<String> schemaElementNames;
    private final String rootElementName;

    ValueGenerator(Random rnd, NameValueProfile profile, List<String> schemaElementNames, String rootElementName) {
        this.rnd = rnd;
        this.profile = profile;
        this.schemaElementNames = schemaElementNames;
        this.rootElementName = rootElementName;
    }

    String generate(String elementLocalName, ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        if (!type.enumerationValues.isEmpty()) {
            return type.enumerationValues.get(rnd.nextInt(type.enumerationValues.size()));
        }
        if (profile.ruleFor(elementLocalName) == NameValueProfile.Rule.ELEMENT_PATH) {
            return clampToLength(elementPath(), type);
        }
        // Currency/country have small, well-known real code lists ("real ISO codes", not just
        // "looks plausible"), so try those before falling through to pattern sampling -- but
        // only accept one if it actually fits this type's own facets, so a schema that further
        // restricts the code list still gets a schema-valid value.
        String realCode = realCodeForWellKnownField(elementLocalName, type);
        if (realCode != null) {
            return realCode;
        }
        if (type.pattern != null) {
            String sampled = sampleWithinLength(type);
            if (sampled != null) {
                return sampled;
            }
        }
        String byName = byElementName(elementLocalName, type);
        if (byName != null) {
            return clampToLength(byName, type);
        }
        return byPrimitive(type);
    }

    /** A path to another element of this same message, e.g. "/Document/CorpActnGnlInf" --
     * for fields like PlcAndNm whose name looks like "place and name" but whose real purpose,
     * per the ISO 20022 usage this toolkit targets, is to point at a path within the message. */
    private String elementPath() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("/Document/").append(rootElementName);
        if (schemaElementNames.isEmpty()) {
            return sb.toString();
        }
        int segments = 1 + rnd.nextInt(3);
        for (int i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
            sb.append('/').append(schemaElementNames.get(rnd.nextInt(schemaElementNames.size())));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private String realCodeForWellKnownField(String name, ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        String n = name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String[] candidates = null;
        if (n.contains("ccy") || n.equals("currency") || n.contains("curr")) {
            candidates = CURRENCIES;
        } else if (n.contains("ctry") || n.contains("country")) {
            candidates = COUNTRIES;
        }
        if (candidates == null) {
            return null;
        }
        List<String> fitting = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String c : candidates) {
            if (fitsConstraints(c, type)) {
                fitting.add(c);
            }
        }
        return fitting.isEmpty() ? null : fitting.get(rnd.nextInt(fitting.size()));
    }

    private boolean fitsConstraints(String candidate, ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        if (type.length != null && candidate.length() != type.length) {
            return false;
        }
        if (type.minLength != null && candidate.length() < type.minLength) {
            return false;
        }
        if (type.maxLength != null && candidate.length() > type.maxLength) {
            return false;
        }
        if (type.pattern != null) {
            try {
                if (!java.util.regex.Pattern.matches(type.pattern, candidate)) {
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (RuntimeException e) {
                return false; // pattern syntax we can't verify in Java regex -- don't risk it
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private String sampleWithinLength(ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt++) {
            String candidate = tryPattern(type.pattern);
            if (candidate == null) {
                return null;
            }
            if (type.length != null && candidate.length() != type.length) {
                continue;
            }
            if (type.minLength != null && candidate.length() < type.minLength) {
                continue;
            }
            if (type.maxLength != null && candidate.length() > type.maxLength) {
                continue;
            }
            return candidate;
        }
        return tryPattern(type.pattern);
    }

    /** RgxGen instances are cached per pattern string since the same facet pattern (e.g. a
     * currency or country code type) typically recurs across many leaves in one document. */
    private String tryPattern(String pattern) {
        try {
            com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.RgxGen generator = patternCache.computeIfAbsent(pattern, p -> {
                var g = new com.github.curiousoddman.rgxgen.RgxGen(p);
                g.setProperties(PATTERN_PROPERTIES);
                return g;
            });
            return generator.generate(rnd);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            return null; // pattern RgxGen can't parse -- caller falls back to byElementName/byPrimitive
        }
    }

    private String byElementName(String name, ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        // The actual declared primitive always wins over a name guess: a field named e.g.
        // "SttlmRate" or "...Amt" could still legitimately be typed xs:date in some schema.
        String primitive = type.primitive.getLocalPart();
        if ("dateTime".equals(primitive)) {
            return realisticDateTime();
        }
        if ("date".equals(primitive)) {
            return realisticDate();
        }
        if ("boolean".equals(primitive)) {
            return String.valueOf(rnd.nextBoolean());
        }

        String n = name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (n.contains("ccy") || n.equals("currency") || n.contains("curr")) {
            return CURRENCIES[rnd.nextInt(CURRENCIES.length)];
        }
        if (n.contains("ctry") || n.contains("country")) {
            return COUNTRIES[rnd.nextInt(COUNTRIES.length)];
        }
        if (n.contains("twnnm") || n.contains("city") || n.contains("town")) {
            return CITIES[rnd.nextInt(CITIES.length)];
        }
        if (n.contains("amt") || n.contains("amount") || n.contains("qty") || n.contains("rate") || n.contains("prc") || n.contains("price")) {
            return realisticDecimal(type);
        }
        if (n.contains("nm") || n.contains("name")) {
            return randomFullName();
        }
        if (n.contains("isin")) {
            return randomIsin();
        }
        if (n.contains("bic") || n.contains("anybic")) {
            return randomBic();
        }
        if (n.contains("iban") || n.contains("acct") || n.contains("account")) {
            return randomAccount();
        }
        if (n.contains("id") || n.contains("ref")) {
            return "REF" + String.format("%010d", Math.abs(rnd.nextLong() % 10_000_000_000L));
        }
        return null;
    }

    private String byPrimitive(ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        String local = type.primitive.getLocalPart();
        return switch (local) {
            case "boolean" -> String.valueOf(rnd.nextBoolean());
            case "integer", "int", "long", "short", "nonNegativeInteger", "positiveInteger" -> String.valueOf(positiveBounded(type, 1, 1_000_000));
            case "decimal" -> realisticDecimal(type);
            case "date" -> realisticDate();
            case "dateTime" -> realisticDateTime();
            case "gYear" -> String.valueOf(2015 + rnd.nextInt(10));
            case "gYearMonth" -> String.format("%04d-%02d", 2015 + rnd.nextInt(10), 1 + rnd.nextInt(12));
            default -> genericString(type);
        };
    }

    private long positiveBounded(ResolvedSimpleType type, long defaultMin, long defaultMax) {
        long min = type.minInclusive != null ? parseLongSafe(type.minInclusive, defaultMin) : defaultMin;
        long max = type.maxInclusive != null ? parseLongSafe(type.maxInclusive, defaultMax) : defaultMax;
        if (max <= min) {
            max = min + 1;
        }
        return min + (Math.abs(rnd.nextLong()) % (max - min));
    }

    private long parseLongSafe(String s, long fallback) {
        try {
            return Long.parseLong(s);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Builds the decimal as a scaled integer (value * 10^fraction) rather than rounding a
     * double: a double's full-precision fractional noise can carry more significant digits
     * than {@code totalDigits} allows once fraction is large, even though XSD's totalDigits
     * ignores insignificant trailing zeros (so a double-rounded, genuinely random fraction can
     * overflow it where an all-zero fraction wouldn't).
     */
    private String realisticDecimal(ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        int fraction = Math.max(0, type.fractionDigits != null ? type.fractionDigits : 2);
        double minD = type.minInclusive != null ? parseDoubleSafe(type.minInclusive, 1) : 1;
        double maxD = type.maxInclusive != null ? parseDoubleSafe(type.maxInclusive, 100_000) : 100_000;
        if (maxD <= minD) {
            maxD = minD + 1000;
        }

        BigInteger scale = BigInteger.TEN.pow(fraction);
        BigInteger minScaled = BigDecimal.valueOf(minD).multiply(new BigDecimal(scale)).toBigInteger();
        BigInteger maxScaled = BigDecimal.valueOf(maxD).multiply(new BigDecimal(scale)).toBigInteger();

        if (type.totalDigits != null) {
            BigInteger digitCap = BigInteger.TEN.pow(type.totalDigits).subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
            if (maxScaled.compareTo(digitCap) > 0) {
                maxScaled = digitCap;
            }
            if (minScaled.compareTo(maxScaled) > 0) {
                minScaled = BigInteger.ZERO;
            }
        }
        if (maxScaled.compareTo(minScaled) <= 0) {
            maxScaled = minScaled.add(BigInteger.ONE);
        }

        BigInteger range = maxScaled.subtract(minScaled);
        BigInteger offset = new BigInteger(range.bitLength() + 8, rnd).mod(range.add(BigInteger.ONE));
        BigInteger chosen = minScaled.add(offset);

        return new BigDecimal(chosen, fraction).toPlainString();
    }

    private double parseDoubleSafe(String s, double fallback) {
        try {
            return Double.parseDouble(s);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private String realisticDate() {
        LocalDate date = RECENT_ANCHOR.minusDays(rnd.nextInt(365 * 3));
        return date.format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE);
    }

    private String realisticDateTime() {
        LocalDateTime dt = RECENT_ANCHOR.atStartOfDay().minusMinutes(rnd.nextInt(60 * 24 * 365 * 3));
        return dt.format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME);
    }

    private String randomFullName() {
        return GIVEN_NAMES[rnd.nextInt(GIVEN_NAMES.length)] + " " + SURNAMES[rnd.nextInt(SURNAMES.length)];
    }

    private String randomIsin() {
        String country = COUNTRIES[rnd.nextInt(COUNTRIES.length)];
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(country);
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            sb.append((char) ('0' + rnd.nextInt(10)));
        }
        sb.append(rnd.nextInt(10));
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private String randomBic() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) sb.append((char) ('A' + rnd.nextInt(26)));
        sb.append(COUNTRIES[rnd.nextInt(COUNTRIES.length)]);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) sb.append((char) ('A' + rnd.nextInt(26)));
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private String randomAccount() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            sb.append((char) ('0' + rnd.nextInt(10)));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private String genericString(ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        int len = targetLength(type);
        List<String> words = List.of("corporate", "action", "movement", "settlement", "balance", "entitlement", "security", "custody", "notice", "advice");
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        while (sb.length() < len) {
            if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(' ');
            sb.append(words.get(rnd.nextInt(words.size())));
        }
        String s = sb.toString();
        return s.length() > len ? s.substring(0, len) : s;
    }

    private int targetLength(ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        if (type.length != null) return type.length;
        int min = type.minLength != null ? type.minLength : 3;
        int max = type.maxLength != null ? type.maxLength : Math.max(min, 20);
        if (max <= min) return min;
        return min + rnd.nextInt(max - min + 1);
    }

    private String clampToLength(String value, ResolvedSimpleType type) {
        if (type.maxLength != null && value.length() > type.maxLength) {
            return value.substring(0, type.maxLength);
        }
        if (type.length != null && value.length() != type.length) {
            if (value.length() > type.length) {
                return value.substring(0, type.length);
            }
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(value);
            while (sb.length() < type.length) sb.append('0');
            return sb.toString();
        }
        return value;
    }
}

@@@=== FILE END ===
@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/generate/XmlInstanceGenerator.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.generate;

import org.apache.ws.commons.schema.*;

import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamWriter;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Walks an XSD element's type tree (sequence/choice/all, attributes, simple content) and
 * streams out one matching XML instance via StAX. Required elements/attributes are always
 * written; optional ones are included about 70% of the time; maxOccurs&gt;1 elements are
 * repeated according to the requested {@link SizeTier}, damped by nesting depth so repeats
 * inside repeats don't explode combinatorially.
 */
final class XmlInstanceGenerator {

    private static final double OPTIONAL_INCLUDE_PROBABILITY = 0.70;
    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 25;
    private static final String NS_PREFIX = "ns";
    private static final String EXT_PREFIX = "ext";
    private static final Set<String> NON_STRING_PRIMITIVES = Set.of(
            "integer", "int", "long", "short", "nonNegativeInteger", "positiveInteger",
            "decimal", "date", "dateTime", "boolean", "gYear", "gYearMonth");
    private static final Set<String> DATE_LIKE_PRIMITIVES = Set.of("date", "dateTime", "gYear", "gYearMonth");
    private static final String INVALID_NAMESPACE_PREFIX = "bad";
    private static final String INVALID_NAMESPACE_URI = "urn:toolkit:invalid-namespace";

    private final SchemaIndex index;
    private final SimpleTypeResolver typeResolver;
    private final ValueGenerator valueGenerator;
    private final int repeatFactor;
    private final Random rnd;
    private final ContentLevel level;
    private final ErrorInjectionContext injection;
    private final List<String> pathStack = new ArrayList<>();
    private final boolean embedSupplementPlaceholder;
    private int anySlotCounter;

    /**
     * @param repeatFactor how many times each maxOccurs&gt;1 element repeats, applied the same
     *                     at every nesting depth. Nested unbounded lists compound multiplicatively
     *                     (factor^N for N nested levels), which is what actually drives output
     *                     size -- calibrated once per XSD+tier by {@link GenerateCommand}. Only
     *                     used at {@link ContentLevel#FULL}; the other levels ignore it.
     * @param injection    null for an ordinary (valid) document; otherwise drives the one-point
     *                     error injection described on {@link ErrorInjectionContext}.
     * @param embedSupplementPlaceholder when true, every xs:any slot gets a uniquely-indexed
     *                     {@code <SupplementPlaceholder idx="N">} marker instead of the ordinary
     *                     filler, for {@link GenerateCommand} to replace with a real, independently
     *                     generated-and-validated supplement document afterward (A7). False keeps
     *                     the original fixed filler unchanged.
     */
    XmlInstanceGenerator(SchemaIndex index, int repeatFactor, Random rnd, NameValueProfile profile, ContentLevel level,
                          ErrorInjectionContext injection, boolean embedSupplementPlaceholder) {
        this.index = index;
        this.typeResolver = new SimpleTypeResolver(index.collection);
        this.valueGenerator = new ValueGenerator(rnd, profile, index.allElementNames(), index.rootElement.getName());
        this.repeatFactor = repeatFactor;
        this.rnd = rnd;
        this.level = level;
        this.injection = injection;
        this.embedSupplementPlaceholder = embedSupplementPlaceholder;
    }

    void writeDocument(XMLStreamWriter writer) throws XMLStreamException {
        writer.writeStartDocument("UTF-8", "1.0");
        writeElement(writer, index.rootElement, 0, true);
        writer.writeEndDocument();
    }

    private void writeElement(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaElement element, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        writeElement(writer, element, depth, false);
    }

    /**
     * Uses a fixed prefix bound once on the root element rather than the StAX writer's
     * "repairing namespaces" auto-prefix, whose internal counter isn't seeded by us and would
     * otherwise make two runs with the same seed emit different (if equally valid) prefixes.
     */
    private void writeElement(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaElement element, int depth, boolean declareNamespace) throws XMLStreamException {
        // A local particle declared with ref="..." carries no name/type of its own -- only the
        // global element it points to does. minOccurs/maxOccurs stay on the referencing particle
        // itself (handled by the caller, writeElementWithOccurs, before this is ever reached), but
        // everything about what gets WRITTEN here -- name, type, attributes, children -- has to
        // come from the resolved target, or this element silently (or, for its name, not so
        // silently -- a null localName crashes the writer) has nothing to write.
        XmlSchemaElement effective = resolveRef(element);
        pathStack.add(effective.getName());
        try {
            String mainNamespace = index.schema.getTargetNamespace();
            // A ref target is always a global element, so its own QName's namespace is exactly
            // right (global elements are implicitly qualified regardless of elementFormDefault) --
            // and it can genuinely differ from this document's main namespace when the ref crosses
            // an xs:import. Every other element keeps using the main schema's namespace, unchanged.
            boolean crossNamespace = element.isRef() && effective.getQName() != null
                    && !effective.getQName().getNamespaceURI().equals(mainNamespace);
            String namespace = crossNamespace ? effective.getQName().getNamespaceURI() : mainNamespace;

            // Only ever applied to a non-root element: swapping the root's own namespace would
            // also break other code that looks for the document's real root tag verbatim (e.g.
            // supplement embedding). A fresh prefix bound right here, rather than reusing NS_PREFIX
            // with a different URI, is what actually changes the serialized element's namespace --
            // repairNamespaces is off, so writeStartElement's URI argument alone doesn't do that.
            if (!declareNamespace && injection != null && injection.isEligible("invalid-namespace")
                    && injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                injection.recordApplied(currentPath(), namespace, INVALID_NAMESPACE_URI);
                writer.writeStartElement(INVALID_NAMESPACE_PREFIX, effective.getName(), INVALID_NAMESPACE_URI);
                writer.writeNamespace(INVALID_NAMESPACE_PREFIX, INVALID_NAMESPACE_URI);
            } else if (crossNamespace) {
                // Same reasoning as above: a prefix bound on this element's own start tag is what
                // actually puts it in the right namespace, not the writeStartElement URI argument.
                writer.writeStartElement(EXT_PREFIX, effective.getName(), namespace);
                writer.writeNamespace(EXT_PREFIX, namespace);
            } else {
                writer.writeStartElement(NS_PREFIX, effective.getName(), namespace);
                if (declareNamespace) {
                    writer.writeNamespace(NS_PREFIX, namespace);
                }
            }

            QName namedType = effective.getSchemaTypeName();
            if (namedType != null && org.apache.ws.commons.schema.constants.Constants.URI_2001_SCHEMA_XSD.equals(namedType.getNamespaceURI())) {
                writer.writeCharacters(leafValue(effective.getName(), typeResolver.resolve(namedType)));
                writer.writeEndElement();
                return;
            }

            XmlSchemaType type = resolveElementType(effective);
            if (type instanceof XmlSchemaComplexType complexType) {
                writeComplexContent(writer, complexType, effective.getName(), depth);
            } else if (type instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleType simpleType) {
                QName typeName = namedType != null ? namedType : simpleType.getQName();
                ResolvedSimpleType resolved = typeResolver.resolve(typeName);
                writer.writeCharacters(leafValue(effective.getName(), resolved));
            } else {
                // Untyped/unresolvable element: write a generic string so the document stays well-formed.
                writer.writeCharacters("VALUE");
            }
            writer.writeEndElement();
        } finally {
            pathStack.remove(pathStack.size() - 1);
        }
    }

    /** Resolves an element="ref" particle to the global element it points to; returns the
     * particle itself unchanged when it isn't a ref (the overwhelmingly common case), or when a
     * ref's target couldn't be resolved (e.g. the referenced namespace's schema failed to load) --
     * in the latter case the caller's existing "untyped/unresolvable" fallback still applies. */
    private XmlSchemaElement resolveRef(XmlSchemaElement element) {
        if (element.isRef()) {
            XmlSchemaElement target = element.getRef().getTarget();
            if (target != null) {
                return target;
            }
        }
        return element;
    }

    private String currentPath() {
        return String.join("/", pathStack);
    }

    /** Applies the chosen error type at most once per document, at a leaf value, when this leaf
     * matches that type's precondition (e.g. invalid-code needs an enumeration). See
     * {@link ErrorInjectionContext}. */
    private String leafValue(String elementName, ResolvedSimpleType resolved) {
        String normal = valueGenerator.generate(elementName, resolved);
        if (injection == null) {
            return normal;
        }
        String path = currentPath();
        if (injection.isEligible("invalid-code") && !resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty()) {
            if (injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                String bad = "ZZZ-NOT-A-VALID-CODE";
                injection.recordApplied(path, normal, bad);
                return bad;
            }
        } else if (injection.isEligible("pattern-break") && resolved.pattern != null) {
            if (injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                String bad = "###BREAKS-PATTERN###";
                injection.recordApplied(path, normal, bad);
                return bad;
            }
        } else if (injection.isEligible("too-long") && resolved.maxLength != null) {
            if (injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                String bad = normal + "X".repeat(resolved.maxLength + 10);
                injection.recordApplied(path, normal, bad);
                return bad;
            }
        } else if (injection.isEligible("wrong-datatype") && isNonStringPrimitive(resolved)) {
            if (injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                String bad = "NOT-A-VALID-" + resolved.primitive.getLocalPart().toUpperCase();
                injection.recordApplied(path, normal, bad);
                return bad;
            }
        } else if (injection.isEligible("invalid-date") && isDateLike(resolved)) {
            if (injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                // Not just non-date garbage (that's "wrong-datatype") -- an out-of-range
                // month/day, so the failure is a format/range violation rather than "not a
                // date-shaped value at all".
                String bad = "9999-13-45";
                injection.recordApplied(path, normal, bad);
                return bad;
            }
        }
        // "invalid-characters" and "malformed-xml" are NOT handled here: the StAX writer silently
        // strips characters the XML spec disallows (verified empirically) rather than passing
        // them through, so both are instead applied as a post-serialization text edit in
        // GenerateCommand, after this generator has produced a normal, valid document.
        return normal;
    }

    private boolean isNonStringPrimitive(ResolvedSimpleType resolved) {
        return resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty() && NON_STRING_PRIMITIVES.contains(resolved.primitive.getLocalPart());
    }

    private boolean isDateLike(ResolvedSimpleType resolved) {
        return resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty() && DATE_LIKE_PRIMITIVES.contains(resolved.primitive.getLocalPart());
    }

    /** Whatever facet-based corruption applies to this type (enum/pattern/maxLength/non-string
     * primitive), or null if nothing about it can be deterministically made invalid -- shared
     * between element leaf values (via the branches above) and attribute values, so "invalid
     * datatype/value" means the same kind of thing in both places. */
    private String corruptionFor(ResolvedSimpleType resolved, String normal) {
        if (!resolved.enumerationValues.isEmpty()) {
            return "ZZZ-NOT-A-VALID-CODE";
        }
        if (resolved.pattern != null) {
            return "###BREAKS-PATTERN###";
        }
        if (resolved.maxLength != null) {
            return normal + "X".repeat(resolved.maxLength + 10);
        }
        if (isNonStringPrimitive(resolved)) {
            return "NOT-A-VALID-" + resolved.primitive.getLocalPart().toUpperCase();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private XmlSchemaType resolveElementType(XmlSchemaElement element) {
        if (element.getSchemaTypeName() != null) {
            XmlSchemaType byName = index.collection.getTypeByQName(element.getSchemaTypeName());
            if (byName != null) {
                return byName;
            }
            return builtinSimpleType(element.getSchemaTypeName());
        }
        return element.getSchemaType();
    }

    private XmlSchemaType builtinSimpleType(QName typeName) {
        // Built-in XSD primitives (e.g. xs:string) aren't registered as named types in the
        // collection; ResolvedSimpleType handles them directly, so a lightweight stand-in works.
        return index.collection.getTypeByQName(typeName);
    }

    private void writeComplexContent(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaComplexType complexType, String elementName, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) {
            return;
        }
        if (complexType.getContentModel() instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleContent simpleContent
                && simpleContent.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaSimpleContentExtension extension) {
            writeAttributes(writer, extension.getAttributes());
            maybeInjectUnexpectedElement(writer);
            ResolvedSimpleType resolved = typeResolver.resolve(extension.getBaseTypeName());
            writer.writeCharacters(leafValue(elementName, resolved));
            return;
        }

        // <xs:complexContent><xs:extension base="..."> / <xs:restriction base="..."> -- very
        // common for type inheritance/reuse -- keeps its own attributes/particle inside the
        // extension/restriction object, NOT on complexType directly. complexType.getAttributes()
        // and complexType.getParticle() are simply null for these, so without this branch every
        // element of such a type silently writes as empty (no exception, nothing invalid-looking
        // to catch in testing -- just quietly wrong).
        if (complexType.getContentModel() instanceof XmlSchemaComplexContent complexContent) {
            writeComplexContentModel(writer, complexContent, depth);
            return;
        }

        if (complexType.getAttributes() != null) {
            writeAttributes(writer, complexType.getAttributes());
        }
        maybeInjectUnexpectedElement(writer);
        XmlSchemaParticle particle = complexType.getParticle();
        if (particle != null) {
            writeParticle(writer, particle, depth);
        }
    }

    private void writeComplexContentModel(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaComplexContent complexContent, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (complexContent.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaComplexContentExtension extension) {
            // Extension APPENDS to the base type's own content, so the base's fields are written
            // first, in order, chasing further ancestors first if the base is itself derived.
            XmlSchemaComplexType base = resolveNamedComplexType(extension.getBaseTypeName());
            if (base != null) {
                writeInheritedContent(writer, base, depth);
            }
            writeAttributes(writer, extension.getAttributes());
            maybeInjectUnexpectedElement(writer);
            if (extension.getParticle() != null) {
                writeParticle(writer, extension.getParticle(), depth);
            }
        } else if (complexContent.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaComplexContentRestriction restriction) {
            // A restriction redefines the content model from scratch -- the base's own
            // attributes/particle are deliberately NOT also written here, only what the
            // restriction itself redeclares.
            writeAttributes(writer, restriction.getAttributes());
            maybeInjectUnexpectedElement(writer);
            if (restriction.getParticle() != null) {
                writeParticle(writer, restriction.getParticle(), depth);
            }
        }
    }

    /** Writes a base type's own attributes/particle for an extension chain, recursing into
     * further ancestors first so a multi-level chain comes out oldest-first. No manifest/injection
     * side effects here -- those stay with the type actually being extended, in
     * {@link #writeComplexContentModel}, so a document gets at most one unexpected-element/
     * namespace-swap point per element regardless of how deep its type hierarchy is. */
    private void writeInheritedContent(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaComplexType base, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (base.getContentModel() instanceof XmlSchemaComplexContent baseComplexContent) {
            if (baseComplexContent.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaComplexContentExtension baseExtension) {
                XmlSchemaComplexType grandBase = resolveNamedComplexType(baseExtension.getBaseTypeName());
                if (grandBase != null) {
                    writeInheritedContent(writer, grandBase, depth);
                }
                writeAttributes(writer, baseExtension.getAttributes());
                if (baseExtension.getParticle() != null) {
                    writeParticle(writer, baseExtension.getParticle(), depth);
                }
            } else if (baseComplexContent.getContent() instanceof XmlSchemaComplexContentRestriction baseRestriction) {
                writeAttributes(writer, baseRestriction.getAttributes());
                if (baseRestriction.getParticle() != null) {
                    writeParticle(writer, baseRestriction.getParticle(), depth);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        if (base.getAttributes() != null) {
            writeAttributes(writer, base.getAttributes());
        }
        if (base.getParticle() != null) {
            writeParticle(writer, base.getParticle(), depth);
        }
    }

    private XmlSchemaComplexType resolveNamedComplexType(QName typeName) {
        if (typeName != null && index.collection.getTypeByQName(typeName) instanceof XmlSchemaComplexType ct) {
            return ct;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Inserts one element the schema never declared, right where this complex element's real
     * content is about to start -- "invalid content was found starting with element ..." is a
     * reliable, universal failure for any complex element, so this needs no facet precondition. */
    private void maybeInjectUnexpectedElement(XMLStreamWriter writer) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (injection != null && injection.isEligible("unexpected-element") && injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
            injection.recordApplied(currentPath(), "(normal content)", "(extra <UnexpectedElement> inserted)");
            String namespace = index.schema.getTargetNamespace();
            writer.writeStartElement(NS_PREFIX, "UnexpectedElement", namespace);
            writer.writeCharacters("unexpected-content");
            writer.writeEndElement();
        }
    }

    private void writeAttributes(XMLStreamWriter writer, List<XmlSchemaAttributeOrGroupRef> attributes) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (attributes == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (XmlSchemaAttributeOrGroupRef item : attributes) {
            if (!(item instanceof XmlSchemaAttribute attr)) {
                continue;
            }
            boolean required = attr.getUse() == XmlSchemaUse.REQUIRED;
            if (injection != null && injection.isEligible("missing-attribute") && required
                    && injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                injection.recordApplied(currentPath() + "/@" + attr.getName(), "(attribute present)", "(attribute omitted)");
                continue;
            }
            if (!required && !includeOptional()) {
                continue;
            }
            ResolvedSimpleType resolved = attr.getSchemaTypeName() != null
                    ? typeResolver.resolve(attr.getSchemaTypeName())
                    : new ResolvedSimpleType();
            String normal = valueGenerator.generate(attr.getName(), resolved);
            String value = normal;
            if (injection != null && injection.isEligible("invalid-attribute-value")) {
                String bad = corruptionFor(resolved, normal);
                if (bad != null && injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
                    injection.recordApplied(currentPath() + "/@" + attr.getName(), normal, bad);
                    value = bad;
                }
            }
            writer.writeAttribute(attr.getName(), value);
        }
    }

    private void writeParticle(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaParticle particle, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaSequence sequence) {
            for (XmlSchemaSequenceMember member : sequence.getItems()) {
                writeParticleMember(writer, member, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaAll all) {
            for (XmlSchemaAllMember member : all.getItems()) {
                writeParticleMember(writer, member, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaChoice choice) {
            writeChoice(writer, choice, depth);
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaGroupRef groupRef) {
            XmlSchemaParticle resolved = groupRef.getParticle();
            if (resolved != null) {
                writeParticle(writer, resolved, depth);
            }
        } else if (particle instanceof XmlSchemaAny) {
            writeAnyFiller(writer);
        }
    }

    private void writeParticleMember(XMLStreamWriter writer, Object member, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (member instanceof XmlSchemaElement element) {
            writeElementWithOccurs(writer, element, depth);
        } else if (member instanceof XmlSchemaParticle particle) {
            writeParticle(writer, particle, depth);
        }
    }

    private void writeChoice(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaChoice choice, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        List<XmlSchemaChoiceMember> items = choice.getItems();
        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        boolean required = choice.getMinOccurs() >= 1;
        if (!required && !includeOptional()) {
            return;
        }
        int repeatCount = repeatCountFor(choice.getMinOccurs(), choice.getMaxOccurs());
        for (int i = 0; i < repeatCount; i++) {
            Object picked = items.get(rnd.nextInt(items.size()));
            writeParticleMember(writer, picked, depth);
        }
    }

    private void writeAnyFiller(XMLStreamWriter writer) throws XMLStreamException {
        if (embedSupplementPlaceholder) {
            writer.writeStartElement("SupplementPlaceholder");
            writer.writeAttribute("idx", String.valueOf(anySlotCounter++));
            writer.writeEndElement();
            return;
        }
        writer.writeStartElement("ExtensionData");
        writer.writeCharacters("supplementary-data");
        writer.writeEndElement();
    }

    private void writeElementWithOccurs(XMLStreamWriter writer, XmlSchemaElement element, int depth) throws XMLStreamException {
        // minOccurs/maxOccurs belong to this particle itself even when it's a ref -- only the
        // name used for logging needs the resolved target (writeElement resolves the ref again,
        // itself, for everything it actually writes).
        boolean required = element.getMinOccurs() >= 1;
        if (injection != null && injection.isEligible("missing-required") && required
                && injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
            injection.recordApplied(currentPath() + "/" + resolveRef(element).getName(), "(element present)", "(element omitted)");
            return;
        }
        if (!required && !includeOptional()) {
            return;
        }
        int repeatCount = repeatCountFor(element.getMinOccurs(), element.getMaxOccurs());
        long maxOccurs = element.getMaxOccurs();
        if (injection != null && injection.isEligible("too-many-repeats") && maxOccurs > 1 && maxOccurs != Long.MAX_VALUE
                && injection.shouldInjectThisOccurrence()) {
            int bad = (int) maxOccurs + 1;
            injection.recordApplied(currentPath() + "/" + resolveRef(element).getName(), "maxOccurs=" + maxOccurs, "wrote " + bad + " occurrences");
            repeatCount = bad;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < repeatCount; i++) {
            writeElement(writer, element, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    /** Level 3 keeps the original probabilistic inclusion; level 1 never includes an optional
     * item, level 2 always does -- both so "required only" and "required + optional" are exact,
     * reproducible content sets rather than another random sample. */
    private boolean includeOptional() {
        return switch (level) {
            case REQUIRED_ONLY -> false;
            case REQUIRED_AND_OPTIONAL -> true;
            case FULL -> rnd.nextDouble() <= OPTIONAL_INCLUDE_PROBABILITY;
        };
    }

    private int repeatCountFor(long minOccurs, long maxOccurs) {
        if (level != ContentLevel.FULL) {
            // "1 occurrence of repeating elements" at levels 1 and 2 -- --size only applies at
            // level 3, so there's no repeatFactor to honor here.
            return (int) Math.max(1, minOccurs);
        }
        if (maxOccurs <= 1) {
            return (int) Math.max(1, minOccurs);
        }
        long cap = maxOccurs == Long.MAX_VALUE ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : maxOccurs;
        long count = Math.max(Math.max(1, minOccurs), repeatFactor);
        return (int) Math.min(cap, count);
    }
}
