package com.project.toolkit;

import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateOptions;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateResult;
import com.project.toolkit.validate.XsdValidatorCache;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class GenerateCommandTest {

    private static final Path SAMPLE_XSD = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_Extension_supl_009_001_11.xsd");
    private static final Path RESOURCES = Path.of("src", "test", "resources");

    @Test
    void defaultCountIsOneThousand() {
        GenerateOptions opts = GenerateOptions.parse(new String[]{"--xsd", SAMPLE_XSD.toString(), "--out", "x"});
        assertEquals(1000, opts.count);
    }

    @Test
    void generatedXmlsAreValid(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 6;
        opts.size = "mixed";
        opts.seed = 42;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);

        assertEquals(6, result.validCount + result.invalidCount);
        assertEquals(0, result.invalidCount, "every generated file should validate against its XSD");

        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(tempDir)) {
            List<Path> xmlFiles = files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList();
            assertEquals(6, xmlFiles.size());
            for (Path xml : xmlFiles) {
                assertTrue(XsdValidatorCache.validate(opts.xsd, xml).valid(), "expected " + xml + " to validate");
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void sameSeedGivesSameOutput(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path outA = tempDir.resolve("a");
        Path outB = tempDir.resolve("b");

        GenerateOptions optsA = new GenerateOptions();
        optsA.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        optsA.out = outA;
        optsA.count = 3;
        optsA.seed = 123;

        GenerateOptions optsB = new GenerateOptions();
        optsB.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        optsB.out = outB;
        optsB.count = 3;
        optsB.seed = 123;

        GenerateCommand.run(optsA);
        GenerateCommand.run(optsB);

        List<Path> filesA = sortedXmlFiles(outA);
        List<Path> filesB = sortedXmlFiles(outB);
        assertEquals(filesA.size(), filesB.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < filesA.size(); i++) {
            assertEquals(Files.readString(filesA.get(i)), Files.readString(filesB.get(i)),
                    "same seed should produce byte-identical XML");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void plcAndNmIsAnElementPathNotAPersonName(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 30;
        opts.size = "medium";
        opts.seed = 7;

        GenerateCommand.run(opts);

        java.util.regex.Pattern tag = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("PlcAndNm>([^<]*)<");
        boolean foundAny = false;
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(tempDir)) {
            for (Path xml : files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
                var matcher = tag.matcher(Files.readString(xml));
                while (matcher.find()) {
                    String value = matcher.group(1);
                    if (value.isBlank()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    foundAny = true;
                    assertTrue(value.startsWith("/Document/"), "PlcAndNm should be an element path, got: " + value);
                    for (String name : new String[]{"James", "Mary", "Robert", "Smith", "Johnson", "Williams"}) {
                        assertFalse(value.contains(name), "PlcAndNm should not contain a person's name, got: " + value);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(foundAny, "expected at least one non-empty PlcAndNm across 30 generated files");
    }

    @Test
    void contentLevelsControlOptionalAndRepeatInclusion(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path outL1 = tempDir.resolve("l1");
        Path outL2 = tempDir.resolve("l2");

        GenerateOptions optsL1 = new GenerateOptions();
        optsL1.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        optsL1.out = outL1;
        optsL1.count = 1;
        optsL1.level = 1;
        optsL1.seed = 5;
        GenerateCommand.run(optsL1);

        GenerateOptions optsL2 = new GenerateOptions();
        optsL2.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        optsL2.out = outL2;
        optsL2.count = 1;
        optsL2.level = 2;
        optsL2.seed = 5;
        GenerateCommand.run(optsL2);

        long sizeL1 = Files.size(onlyXmlFile(outL1));
        long sizeL2 = Files.size(onlyXmlFile(outL2));
        assertTrue(sizeL1 < sizeL2, "level 1 (required only) should be smaller than level 2 (required + optional): "
                + sizeL1 + " vs " + sizeL2);
        assertTrue(XsdValidatorCache.validate(SAMPLE_XSD, onlyXmlFile(outL1)).valid(), "level 1 output should still validate");
        assertTrue(XsdValidatorCache.validate(SAMPLE_XSD, onlyXmlFile(outL2)).valid(), "level 2 output should still validate");
    }

    @Test
    void everyErrorTypeThisXsdSupportsReliablyFailsValidationForItsRecordedReason(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        for (String errorType : List.of("missing-required", "invalid-code", "pattern-break",
                "too-long", "wrong-datatype", "invalid-characters", "malformed-xml",
                "invalid-date", "missing-attribute", "invalid-attribute-value", "invalid-namespace", "unexpected-element")) {
            Path out = tempDir.resolve(errorType);
            GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
            opts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
            opts.out = out;
            opts.count = 3;
            opts.level = 2;
            opts.seed = 99;
            opts.errorPercent = 100;
            opts.errorTypes = List.of(errorType);

            GenerateCommand.run(opts);

            try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(out)) {
                for (Path xml : files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
                    assertFalse(XsdValidatorCache.validate(SAMPLE_XSD, xml).valid(),
                            errorType + ": " + xml.getFileName() + " should fail validation but didn't");
                }
            }

            String manifest = Files.readString(out.resolve("manifest.csv"));
            assertTrue(manifest.lines().skip(1).allMatch(l -> l.contains(",error,")),
                    errorType + ": every row should be marked as an error at --error-percent 100:\n" + manifest);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void embedsAValidSupplementDocumentInsideXsAnySlots(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path seev035 = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_seev_035_001_16.xsd");
        Path supl009 = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_Extension_supl_009_001_11.xsd");

        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = seev035;
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 5;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 3;
        opts.supplement = supl009;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);
        assertEquals(0, result.invalidCount, "the outer document should still validate with a supplement embedded");

        boolean foundSupplement = false;
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(tempDir)) {
            for (Path xml : files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
                String text = Files.readString(xml);
                int envlpStart = text.indexOf(":Envlp>");
                if (envlpStart < 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                assertTrue(text.contains("urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:supl.009.001.11"),
                        "Envlp should contain a document in the supl.009 namespace: " + xml);
                foundSupplement = true;

                // Extract just the embedded supl.009 Document and validate it independently
                // against its own XSD, per A7.
                int docStart = text.indexOf("<ns:Document xmlns:ns=\"urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:supl.009.001.11\">", envlpStart);
                int docEnd = text.indexOf("</ns:Document>", docStart) + "</ns:Document>".length();
                String fragment = text.substring(docStart, docEnd);
                Path fragFile = tempDir.resolve(xml.getFileName() + ".supplement.xml");
                Files.writeString(fragFile, "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>" + fragment);
                assertTrue(XsdValidatorCache.validate(supl009, fragFile).valid(),
                        "embedded supplement fragment should independently validate against supl.009: " + xml);
            }
        }
        assertTrue(foundSupplement, "expected at least one SplmtryData/Envlp with an embedded supplement across 5 files");
    }

    @Test
    void sameSeedGivesSameOutputRegardlessOfThreadCount(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path outSingle = tempDir.resolve("single");
        Path outMulti = tempDir.resolve("multi");

        GenerateOptions optsSingle = new GenerateOptions();
        optsSingle.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        optsSingle.out = outSingle;
        optsSingle.count = 9;
        optsSingle.seed = 55;
        optsSingle.threads = 1;

        GenerateOptions optsMulti = new GenerateOptions();
        optsMulti.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        optsMulti.out = outMulti;
        optsMulti.count = 9;
        optsMulti.seed = 55;
        optsMulti.threads = 4;

        GenerateCommand.run(optsSingle);
        GenerateCommand.run(optsMulti);

        List<Path> filesSingle = sortedXmlFiles(outSingle);
        List<Path> filesMulti = sortedXmlFiles(outMulti);
        assertEquals(filesSingle.size(), filesMulti.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < filesSingle.size(); i++) {
            assertEquals(Files.readString(filesSingle.get(i)), Files.readString(filesMulti.get(i)),
                    "thread count should not affect output (file ordering/content must stay deterministic)");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void zipOutputContainsTheSameValidFilesAsFolderOutput(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path folderOut = tempDir.resolve("folder");
        Path zipOut = tempDir.resolve("out.zip");

        GenerateOptions folderOpts = new GenerateOptions();
        folderOpts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        folderOpts.out = folderOut;
        folderOpts.count = 4;
        folderOpts.level = 2;
        folderOpts.seed = 17;
        GenerateCommand.run(folderOpts);

        GenerateOptions zipOpts = new GenerateOptions();
        zipOpts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        zipOpts.out = zipOut;
        zipOpts.count = 4;
        zipOpts.level = 2;
        zipOpts.seed = 17;
        zipOpts.output = "zip";
        GenerateResult zipResult = GenerateCommand.run(zipOpts);
        assertEquals(0, zipResult.invalidCount);

        List<Path> folderFiles = sortedXmlFiles(folderOut);
        assertEquals(4, folderFiles.size());

        try (var zipFile = new java.util.zip.ZipFile(zipOut.toFile())) {
            assertEquals(4, zipFile.stream().filter(e -> e.getName().endsWith(".xml")).count());
            for (Path f : folderFiles) {
                var entry = zipFile.getEntry(f.getFileName().toString());
                assertNotNull(entry, "zip should contain " + f.getFileName());
                String zippedContent = new String(zipFile.getInputStream(entry).readAllBytes(), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                assertEquals(Files.readString(f), zippedContent, "zip entry content should match the folder-mode file byte for byte");
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void zipOutputContainsOnlyXmlFilesWithReportsWrittenBesideIt(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path zipOut = tempDir.resolve("out.zip");

        GenerateOptions zipOpts = new GenerateOptions();
        zipOpts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        zipOpts.out = zipOut;
        zipOpts.count = 4;
        zipOpts.level = 2;
        zipOpts.seed = 23;
        zipOpts.output = "zip";
        GenerateCommand.run(zipOpts);

        try (var zipFile = new java.util.zip.ZipFile(zipOut.toFile())) {
            List<String> entryNames = zipFile.stream().map(java.util.zip.ZipEntry::getName).toList();
            assertEquals(4, entryNames.size(), "zip should contain only the 4 generated XML files: " + entryNames);
            assertTrue(entryNames.stream().allMatch(n -> n.endsWith(".xml")), "zip should contain only .xml entries: " + entryNames);
            assertTrue(entryNames.stream().noneMatch(n -> n.startsWith("report.") || n.startsWith("manifest.")),
                    "zip should not contain report/manifest files: " + entryNames);
        }

        // The reports/manifests still get generated every run -- just beside the zip, not inside it.
        Path jobDir = zipOut.getParent();
        for (String name : List.of("report.json", "report.csv", "manifest.json", "manifest.csv")) {
            assertTrue(Files.exists(jobDir.resolve(name)), name + " should be written beside the zip");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void everyRunWritesAReportAndManifestInJsonAndCsv(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = SAMPLE_XSD;
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 6;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 21;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);

        for (String name : List.of("report.json", "report.csv", "manifest.json", "manifest.csv")) {
            assertTrue(Files.exists(tempDir.resolve(name)), name + " should always be written, not just for error-injection runs");
        }
        String reportJson = Files.readString(tempDir.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(reportJson.contains("\"seed\":21"), "report.json should echo the seed used:\n" + reportJson);
        assertTrue(reportJson.contains("\"valid\":" + result.validCount), "report.json's valid count should match the real result:\n" + reportJson);

        long manifestRows = Files.readString(tempDir.resolve("manifest.csv")).lines().skip(1).count();
        assertEquals(6, manifestRows, "manifest should have one row per generated file");
    }

    @Test
    void complexContentExtensionIsFullyPopulatedNotEmpty(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = RESOURCES.resolve("complex-content-extension.xsd");
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 5;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 11;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);
        assertEquals(0, result.invalidCount, "every field inherited through complexContent extension should be populated and valid");

        for (Path xml : xmlFilesIn(tempDir)) {
            String text = Files.readString(xml);
            // Each level of the two-deep extension chain (BaseType -> MidType -> ExtendedType)
            // contributes one field; none should be missing, and the element must not have
            // collapsed to an empty/self-closed tag.
            assertTrue(text.contains("<ns:BaseField>"), "base type's field missing:\n" + text);
            assertTrue(text.contains("<ns:MidField>"), "mid type's field missing:\n" + text);
            assertTrue(text.contains("<ns:ExtraField>"), "extending type's own field missing:\n" + text);
            assertTrue(text.contains("<ns:Count>"), "extending type's own field missing:\n" + text);
            assertFalse(text.contains("<ns:Body/>"), "Body should not have collapsed to an empty element:\n" + text);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void elementRefResolvesToItsTargetsNameAndType(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = RESOURCES.resolve("element-ref.xsd");
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 3;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 12;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);
        assertEquals(0, result.invalidCount, "a <xs:element ref=\"...\"/> particle should resolve to its target's name and type");

        for (Path xml : xmlFilesIn(tempDir)) {
            String text = Files.readString(xml);
            assertTrue(text.matches("(?s).*<ns:PersonName>[^<]+</ns:PersonName>.*"), "ref-resolved element missing or empty:\n" + text);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void includedSchemaFileIsResolvedRelativeToTheMainXsd(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = RESOURCES.resolve("import-main.xsd");
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 3;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 13;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);
        assertEquals(0, result.invalidCount, "a type from an xs:include'd file should resolve and populate normally");

        for (Path xml : xmlFilesIn(tempDir)) {
            String text = Files.readString(xml);
            assertTrue(text.contains("<ns:Street>") && text.contains("<ns:City>"), "included type's fields missing:\n" + text);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void importedSchemaAcrossNamespacesResolvesAndKeepsItsOwnNamespace(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = RESOURCES.resolve("import-ref-main.xsd");
        opts.out = tempDir;
        opts.count = 3;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 14;

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);
        assertEquals(0, result.invalidCount, "a ref into an xs:import'd, differently-namespaced schema should resolve and validate");

        for (Path xml : xmlFilesIn(tempDir)) {
            String text = Files.readString(xml);
            assertTrue(text.contains("xmlns:ext=\"urn:test:import-ref-common\""), "cross-namespace element should declare its own namespace:\n" + text);
            assertTrue(text.matches("(?s).*<ext:PersonName[^>]*>[^<]+</ext:PersonName>.*"), "cross-namespace ref element missing or empty:\n" + text);
        }
    }

    private static List<Path> xmlFilesIn(Path dir) throws IOException {
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(dir)) {
            return files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList();
        }
    }

    private static Path onlyXmlFile(Path dir) throws IOException {
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(dir)) {
            return files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        }
    }

    private static List<Path> sortedXmlFiles(Path dir) throws IOException {
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(dir)) {
            return files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).sorted().toList();
        }
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit;

import com.project.toolkit.infer.InferCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.infer.InferOptions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class InferCommandTest {

    @Test
    void detectsOptionalAndRepeatingAndDatatypes(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample1.xml"), """
                <Order>
                    <Qty>1001</Qty>
                    <Note>first order</Note>
                    <Item>A</Item>
                    <Item>B</Item>
                    <Item>C</Item>
                </Order>
                """);
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample2.xml"), """
                <Order>
                    <Qty>1002</Qty>
                    <Item>A</Item>
                </Order>
                """);

        InferOptions opts = new InferOptions();
        opts.xmlInput = tempDir;
        opts.outXsd = tempDir.resolve("inferred.xsd");

        InferCommand.run(opts);

        String xsd = Files.readString(opts.outXsd);
        assertTrue(Files.exists(opts.outXsd));

        // Qty appeared in every file as an integer -> required, xs:integer
        assertTrue(xsd.contains("name=\"Qty\" type=\"xs:integer\""), "Qty should be inferred as a required integer:\n" + xsd);

        // Note appeared only in sample1 -> optional
        assertTrue(xsd.contains("name=\"Note\" type=\"xs:string\" minOccurs=\"0\""), "Note should be optional:\n" + xsd);

        // Item repeated 3 times in sample1 -> maxOccurs unbounded
        assertTrue(xsd.contains("name=\"Item\"") && xsd.contains("maxOccurs=\"unbounded\""), "Item should repeat:\n" + xsd);

        Path report = tempDir.resolve("inferred_review.md");
        assertTrue(Files.exists(report), "review report should be written next to the XSD");
        String reportText = Files.readString(report);
        assertTrue(reportText.contains("Note"), "review report should mention the optional Note field:\n" + reportText);
    }

    @Test
    void keepsIdRefNbFieldsAsStringToPreserveLeadingZeros(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        // Every sample's OrdId "looks like" an integer, but it has a leading zero -- coercing it
        // to xs:integer would be lossy, so the Id/Ref/Nb tag-name rule keeps it as xs:string.
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample1.xml"), "<Order><OrdId>00042</OrdId></Order>");
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample2.xml"), "<Order><OrdId>00099</OrdId></Order>");

        InferOptions opts = new InferOptions();
        opts.xmlInput = tempDir;
        opts.outXsd = tempDir.resolve("inferred.xsd");

        InferCommand.run(opts);

        String xsd = Files.readString(opts.outXsd);
        assertTrue(xsd.contains("name=\"OrdId\" type=\"xs:string\""), "OrdId should stay xs:string, not be coerced to a number:\n" + xsd);
    }

    @Test
    void infersTrueOrderEvenWhenFirstSampleIsMissingAnEarlyOptionalElement(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        // Alphabetically first, so scanned first: "A" is optional and happens to be missing
        // here, so a naive first-seen-order writer would place "B" before "A" in the XSD.
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample1.xml"), "<Root><B>b1</B><C>c1</C></Root>");
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample2.xml"), "<Root><A>a2</A><B>b2</B><C>c2</C></Root>");
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample3.xml"), "<Root><B>b3</B><C>c3</C></Root>");

        InferOptions opts = new InferOptions();
        opts.xmlInput = tempDir;
        opts.outXsd = tempDir.resolve("inferred.xsd");

        InferCommand.run(opts);

        String xsd = Files.readString(opts.outXsd);
        int posA = xsd.indexOf("name=\"A\"");
        int posB = xsd.indexOf("name=\"B\"");
        int posC = xsd.indexOf("name=\"C\"");
        assertTrue(posA >= 0 && posA < posB && posB < posC,
                "declared order should be A, B, C (the true order seen in sample2), not scan-discovery order:\n" + xsd);
    }

    @Test
    void mergesStructurallyIdenticalComplexTypes(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        // WrapA and WrapB both wrap a single required integer "Val" -- structurally identical,
        // so they should end up sharing one named complexType instead of getting one each.
        Files.writeString(tempDir.resolve("sample1.xml"), "<Root><WrapA><Val>1</Val></WrapA><WrapB><Val>2</Val></WrapB></Root>");

        InferOptions opts = new InferOptions();
        opts.xmlInput = tempDir;
        opts.outXsd = tempDir.resolve("inferred.xsd");

        InferCommand.run(opts);

        String xsd = Files.readString(opts.outXsd);
        assertFalse(xsd.contains("WrapBType"), "WrapB should not get its own type:\n" + xsd);
        assertTrue(xsd.contains("name=\"WrapA\" type=\"WrapAType\"") && xsd.contains("name=\"WrapB\" type=\"WrapAType\""),
                "WrapA and WrapB should both reference the same shared complexType:\n" + xsd);
    }

    @Test
    void warnsWhenOnlyOneSampleGiven(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws IOException {
        Path xml = tempDir.resolve("only.xml");
        Files.writeString(xml, "<Root><A>1</A></Root>");

        InferOptions opts = new InferOptions();
        opts.xmlInput = xml;
        opts.outXsd = tempDir.resolve("only.xsd");

        InferCommand.run(opts);

        String report = Files.readString(tempDir.resolve("only_review.md"));
        assertTrue(report.toLowerCase().contains("warning"), "should warn about single-sample input:\n" + report);
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit/src/test/java/com/project/toolkit/SchemaScanTest.java ===
package com.project.toolkit;

import com.project.toolkit.generate.ScanCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.SchemaScanResult;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.nio.file.Path;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class SchemaScanTest {

    private static final Path SAMPLE_XSD = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_Extension_supl_009_001_11.xsd");

    @Test
    void reportsCountsAndGatesErrorTypesByWhatTheSchemaActuallyHas() {
        SchemaScanResult result = ScanCommand.run(SAMPLE_XSD);

        assertTrue(result.requiredCount > 0);
        assertTrue(result.enumerationCount > 0);
        assertTrue(result.possibleLevels.containsAll(java.util.List.of(1, 2, 3)));

        // This XSD has enumerations and patterns, so those error types should be offered...
        assertTrue(result.possibleErrorTypes.contains("invalid-code"));
        assertTrue(result.possibleErrorTypes.contains("pattern-break"));
        // ...but every repeating element in it uses maxOccurs="unbounded" (finiteRepeatCount==0),
        // so "too-many-repeats" -- which needs a finite cap to exceed -- must not be offered.
        assertEquals(0, result.finiteRepeatCount);
        assertFalse(result.possibleErrorTypes.contains("too-many-repeats"));
        // Always offered regardless of schema content:
        assertTrue(result.possibleErrorTypes.containsAll(java.util.List.of("malformed-xml", "invalid-characters", "wrong-datatype")));
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.config;

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * App-level configuration (see application.yml, prefix "app"). {@code allowedBaseFolders} is
 * the whitelist a server-side path (schema upload target, infer {@code serverPath} input) must
 * resolve inside -- the only thing standing between "read any file the server process can see"
 * and a legitimate feature, so every server-path-accepting endpoint must check it.
 */
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "app")
public final class AppProperties {

    private List<String> allowedBaseFolders = List.of();
    private String dataDir = "xml-toolkit-api-data";
    private long maxUploadBytes = 50L * 1024 * 1024;

    public List<Path> allowedBaseFolderPaths() {
        return allowedBaseFolders.stream().map(Path::of).map(Path::toAbsolutePath).map(Path::normalize).toList();
    }

    public List<String> getAllowedBaseFolders() {
        return allowedBaseFolders;
    }

    public void setAllowedBaseFolders(List<String> allowedBaseFolders) {
        this.allowedBaseFolders = allowedBaseFolders;
    }

    public String getDataDir() {
        return dataDir;
    }

    public void setDataDir(String dataDir) {
        this.dataDir = dataDir;
    }

    public long getMaxUploadBytes() {
        return maxUploadBytes;
    }

    public void setMaxUploadBytes(long maxUploadBytes) {
        this.maxUploadBytes = maxUploadBytes;
    }
}

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.CorsRegistry;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;

/** Allows the Vite dev server (a different origin/port than this API) to call it during local
 * development -- this is a local tool, not a multi-tenant public service, so an open CORS policy
 * on /api/** is the right tradeoff here. */
@Configuration
public class CorsConfig implements WebMvcConfigurer {
    @Override
    public void addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry registry) {
        registry.addMapping("/api/**").allowedOriginPatterns("*").allowedMethods("*").allowedHeaders("*");
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.controller;

import com.project.toolkit.api.dto.GenerateRequest;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.Job;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.SchemaRecord;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.GenerateService;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.HistoryService;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.JobService;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.SchemaService;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/generate")
public class GenerateController {

    private final SchemaService schemaService;
    private final JobService jobService;
    private final HistoryService historyService;
    private final GenerateService generateService;

    public GenerateController(SchemaService schemaService, JobService jobService,
                               HistoryService historyService, GenerateService generateService) {
        this.schemaService = schemaService;
        this.jobService = jobService;
        this.historyService = historyService;
        this.generateService = generateService;
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> generate(@RequestBody GenerateRequest req) throws java.io.IOException {
        if (req.schemaId() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "schemaId is required");
        }
        SchemaRecord schema = schemaService.get(req.schemaId())
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No such schema: " + req.schemaId()));

        Job job = jobService.submit("generate", j -> generateService.runGenerate(j, schema, req));
        historyService.record("generate", job.id, req);
        return ResponseEntity.accepted().body(Map.of("jobId", job.id));
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.controller;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.HistoryEntry;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.HistoryService;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/history")
public class HistoryController {

    private final HistoryService historyService;
    private final GenerateController generateController;

    public HistoryController(HistoryService historyService, GenerateController generateController) {
        this.historyService = historyService;
        this.generateController = generateController;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public List<HistoryEntry> list() {
        return historyService.list();
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/rerun")
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> rerun(@PathVariable String id) throws Exception {
        HistoryEntry entry = historyService.get(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No such history entry: " + id));
        if (!"generate".equals(entry.type()) || entry.request() == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
                    "Only 'generate' history entries can be re-run (an 'infer' entry's original upload isn't retained)");
        }
        return generateController.generate(entry.request());
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/controller/InferController.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.controller;

import com.project.toolkit.api.dto.InferDecisionsRequest;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.Job;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.SchemaRecord;
import com.project.toolkit.api.repository.DecisionRepository;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.InferService;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.JobService;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.SchemaService;
import com.project.toolkit.api.util.ReviewJsonFilter;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.ContentDisposition;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/infer")
public class InferController {

    private final JobService jobService;
    private final InferService inferService;
    private final DecisionRepository decisionRepository;
    private final SchemaService schemaService;

    public InferController(JobService jobService, InferService inferService,
                            DecisionRepository decisionRepository, SchemaService schemaService) {
        this.jobService = jobService;
        this.inferService = inferService;
        this.decisionRepository = decisionRepository;
        this.schemaService = schemaService;
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> infer(@RequestParam(required = false) MultipartFile zip,
                                                       @RequestParam(required = false) MultipartFile[] files,
                                                       @RequestParam(required = false) String serverPath,
                                                       @RequestParam(required = false) String baselineSchemaId,
                                                       @RequestParam(required = false) Integer maxSamples) throws IOException {
        Path baselineXsd = baselineSchemaId == null ? null
                : schemaService.xsdPath(schemaService.get(baselineSchemaId).orElseThrow(() ->
                        new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "No such baseline schema: " + baselineSchemaId)));

        // Staged synchronously, on this request thread: the servlet container is free to clean up
        // multipart temp files as soon as the request completes, which would otherwise race an
        // async job that hasn't read them yet.
        Path staged = inferService.stageUpload(zip, files, serverPath);
        Job job = jobService.submit("infer", j -> inferService.runInfer(j, staged, serverPath, baselineXsd, maxSamples));
        return ResponseEntity.accepted().body(Map.of("jobId", job.id));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/groups")
    public Map<String, Object> groups(@PathVariable String id) {
        Job job = find(id);
        return Map.of(
                "groups", job.attributes.getOrDefault("groups", List.of()),
                "brokenFiles", job.attributes.getOrDefault("brokenFiles", List.of()),
                "unknownFiles", List.of()
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/review")
    public ResponseEntity<String> review(@PathVariable String id, @RequestParam(required = false) String group) throws IOException {
        Job job = find(id);
        InferService.GroupInferenceResult result = groupResult(job, group);
        String groupKey = result.group().groupKey();
        Map<String, String> existingDecisions = decisionRepository.decisionsFor(groupKey);

        String json = Files.readString(result.reviewJsonPath());
        // Field paths with a recorded decision aren't asked about again (the API spec's "apply
        // automatically next time" rule).
        if (!existingDecisions.isEmpty()) {
            json = ReviewJsonFilter.filterOutDecidedPaths(json, existingDecisions);
        }
        return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).body(json);
    }

    /** Per-group XSD download -- the generic GET /api/jobs/{id}/download only works when a job
     * produced exactly one group's result, so a multi-group infer job needs this instead. */
    @GetMapping("/{id}/xsd")
    public ResponseEntity<FileSystemResource> xsd(@PathVariable String id, @RequestParam(required = false) String group) {
        Job job = find(id);
        InferService.GroupInferenceResult result = groupResult(job, group);
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_XML)
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, ContentDisposition.attachment().filename("inferred.xsd").build().toString())
                .body(new FileSystemResource(result.xsdPath()));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/decisions")
    public Map<String, Object> decisions(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody InferDecisionsRequest req) throws IOException {
        Job job = find(id);
        InferService.GroupInferenceResult result = groupResult(job, req.group());
        String groupKey = result.group().groupKey();
        decisionRepository.record(groupKey, req.decisions());

        // Re-validate the group's samples against its current XSD. The engine doesn't yet
        // restructure the XSD from individual field decisions (recorded above for reuse, per
        // the spec's "remember... apply automatically next time" -- but this build only avoids
        // re-asking about them, it doesn't yet rewrite the schema from them); this reports the
        // real, current validation count rather than a number implying more happened.
        int[] counts = inferService.revalidateGroup(result.xsdPath(), result.xsdPath().getParent().resolve("samples"));
        return Map.of("group", groupKey, "validSamples", counts[0], "totalSamples", counts[1],
                "note", "Decisions are recorded and won't be re-asked about; only enumeration/datatype "
                        + "decisions that change the XSD text are reflected in validSamples/totalSamples above.");
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/register")
    public ResponseEntity<SchemaRecord> register(@PathVariable String id,
                                                  @RequestParam(required = false) String group,
                                                  @RequestParam(required = false) String name) throws IOException {
        Job job = find(id);
        InferService.GroupInferenceResult result = groupResult(job, group);
        String effectiveName = name != null ? name : result.group().rootElementName();
        try (var in = Files.newInputStream(result.xsdPath())) {
            SchemaRecord record = schemaService.register(effectiveName, in, null);
            return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(record);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private InferService.GroupInferenceResult groupResult(Job job, String groupKey) {
        List<InferService.GroupInferenceResult> results =
                (List<InferService.GroupInferenceResult>) job.attributes.get("groupResults");
        if (results == null || results.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Job has no inferred groups yet");
        }
        if (groupKey == null) {
            return results.get(0);
        }
        return results.stream().filter(r -> r.group().groupKey().equals(groupKey)).findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No such group: " + groupKey));
    }

    private Job find(String id) {
        return jobService.find(id).orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No such job: " + id));
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/controller/JobController.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.controller;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.Job;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.JobStatus;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.JobService;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.ContentDisposition;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/jobs")
public class JobController {

    private final JobService jobService;

    public JobController(JobService jobService) {
        this.jobService = jobService;
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    public Map<String, Object> status(@PathVariable String id) {
        Job job = find(id);
        return Map.of(
                "jobId", job.id,
                "type", job.type,
                "status", job.status.name(),
                "progressPercent", job.progressPercent,
                "errorMessage", job.errorMessage == null ? "" : job.errorMessage,
                "createdAt", job.createdAt.toString()
        );
    }

    @GetMapping(value = "/{id}/events", produces = "text/event-stream")
    public SseEmitter events(@PathVariable String id) {
        find(id); // 404 before opening the stream if the job doesn't exist
        return jobService.subscribe(id);
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/cancel")
    public Map<String, Object> cancel(@PathVariable String id) {
        find(id);
        boolean cancelled = jobService.cancel(id);
        return Map.of("jobId", id, "cancelled", cancelled);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/download")
    public ResponseEntity<FileSystemResource> download(@PathVariable String id) throws IOException {
        Job job = find(id);
        requireFinished(job);
        Path path = Path.of((String) requireAttribute(job, "downloadPath"));
        String contentType = (String) job.attributes.getOrDefault("downloadContentType", "application/octet-stream");
        String fileName = (String) job.attributes.getOrDefault("downloadFileName", path.getFileName().toString());

        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType(contentType))
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, ContentDisposition.attachment().filename(fileName).build().toString())
                .body(new FileSystemResource(path));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/report")
    public ResponseEntity<String> report(@PathVariable String id,
                                          @RequestParam(defaultValue = "json") String format) throws IOException {
        Job job = find(id);
        requireFinished(job);
        if (!"json".equals(format) && !"csv".equals(format)) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "format must be json or csv");
        }

        // Both job types write report.json/csv as a loose file beside their other output rather
        // than bundling it into a downloadable zip (generate's zip is meant to be XML documents
        // only), so both read the same way here.
        String key = "json".equals(format) ? "reportJsonPath" : "reportCsvPath";
        Object pathAttr = job.attributes.get(key);
        if (pathAttr == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No " + format + " report for this job type");
        }
        String content = Files.readString(Path.of((String) pathAttr));

        MediaType mediaType = "json".equals(format) ? MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON : MediaType.valueOf("text/csv");
        return ResponseEntity.ok().contentType(mediaType).body(content);
    }

    private Job find(String id) {
        return jobService.find(id).orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No such job: " + id));
    }

    private void requireFinished(Job job) {
        if (job.status != JobStatus.SUCCEEDED) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Job is " + job.status.name().toLowerCase() + ", not finished successfully yet");
        }
    }

    private Object requireAttribute(Job job, String key) {
        Object value = job.attributes.get(key);
        if (value == null) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Job has no " + key);
        }
        return value;
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.controller;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.SchemaRecord;
import com.project.toolkit.api.service.SchemaService;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.ScanCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.SchemaScanResult;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.ContentDisposition;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/schemas")
public class SchemaController {

    private final SchemaService schemaService;

    public SchemaController(SchemaService schemaService) {
        this.schemaService = schemaService;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public List<SchemaRecord> list() {
        return schemaService.list();
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<SchemaRecord> register(@RequestParam("file") MultipartFile file,
                                                  @RequestParam(value = "name", required = false) String name,
                                                  @RequestParam(value = "linkedSupplementId", required = false) String linkedSupplementId) throws IOException {
        if (file.isEmpty()) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "file is required");
        }
        String effectiveName = (name != null && !name.isBlank()) ? name : file.getOriginalFilename();
        SchemaRecord record = schemaService.register(effectiveName, file.getInputStream(), linkedSupplementId);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(record);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/scan")
    public SchemaScanResult scan(@PathVariable String id) {
        SchemaRecord record = find(id);
        return ScanCommand.run(schemaService.xsdPath(record));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}/download")
    public ResponseEntity<FileSystemResource> download(@PathVariable String id) {
        SchemaRecord record = find(id);
        String fileName = (record.name() != null ? record.name() : record.rootElementName()) + ".xsd";
        return ResponseEntity.ok()
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_XML)
                .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_DISPOSITION, ContentDisposition.attachment().filename(fileName).build().toString())
                .body(new FileSystemResource(schemaService.xsdPath(record)));
    }

    private SchemaRecord find(String id) {
        return schemaService.get(id).orElseThrow(() ->
                new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "No such schema: " + id));
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/entity/Job.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.entity;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;

/** One background unit of work (a generate or infer run) and its live state. Every long action
 * in the API returns a {@code jobId} referencing one of these (per the API spec). */
public final class Job {

    public final String id;
    public final String type; // "generate" | "infer"
    public final Instant createdAt = Instant.now();
    public final AtomicBoolean cancelRequested = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    public final List<java.util.function.Consumer<Map<String, Object>>> eventListeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();

    public volatile JobStatus status = JobStatus.PENDING;
    public volatile int progressPercent = 0;
    public volatile String errorMessage;
    public volatile Object result;
    /** Extra fields a specific job type wants to expose via GET /api/jobs/{id} and SSE events
     * (e.g. infer's groups once computed) without every job type needing its own DTO. */
    public final Map<String, Object> attributes = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public Job(String id, String type) {
        this.id = id;
        this.type = type;
    }

    /** Public (not package-private as originally, since the entity/service package split means
     * JobService -- the only caller -- now lives outside this package). */
    public void emit(Map<String, Object> event) {
        for (var listener : eventListeners) {
            listener.accept(event);
        }
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.exception;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;

import java.util.Map;

/** Translates exception types that don't already carry an HTTP status (via
 * {@link org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException}) into one, instead of a bare
 * 500. Controllers and services keep throwing plain exceptions; this is the only place that maps
 * them to a response. */
@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(SecurityException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleSecurity(SecurityException e) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN).body(Map.of("error", e.getMessage()));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleIllegalArgument(IllegalArgumentException e) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(Map.of("error", e.getMessage()));
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.repository;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.project.toolkit.api.config.AppProperties;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Remembers a human's decision on one reviewed field (accept/reject a suggestion, override a
 * value) keyed by (group key, field path), persisted across restarts, so the next inference run
 * on the same message type doesn't ask about the same field again (the API spec's closing rule).
 */
@Repository
public final class DecisionRepository {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    /** groupKey -> (fieldPath -> decision) */
    private final Map<String, Map<String, String>> decisions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Path file;

    public DecisionRepository(AppProperties properties) throws IOException {
        this.file = Path.of(properties.getDataDir()).resolve("decisions.json");
        load();
    }

    public synchronized void record(String groupKey, Map<String, String> fieldDecisions) throws IOException {
        decisions.computeIfAbsent(groupKey, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).putAll(fieldDecisions);
        save();
    }

    public Map<String, String> decisionsFor(String groupKey) {
        return decisions.getOrDefault(groupKey, Map.of());
    }

    public boolean hasDecision(String groupKey, String fieldPath) {
        return decisionsFor(groupKey).containsKey(fieldPath);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private void load() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(file)) {
            return;
        }
        Map<String, Map<String, String>> loaded = MAPPER.readValue(file.toFile(), Map.class);
        decisions.putAll(loaded);
    }

    private void save() throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
        MAPPER.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(file.toFile(), decisions);
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.repository;

import com.project.toolkit.api.config.AppProperties;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.HistoryEntry;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/** Pure file-based persistence for history entries: the in-memory list and the history.json
 * backing file. Entry construction (id/timestamp assignment) is
 * {@link com.project.toolkit.api.service.HistoryService}'s job, not this class's. */
@Repository
public final class HistoryRepository {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper().registerModule(new JavaTimeModule());

    private final List<HistoryEntry> entries = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final Path file;

    public HistoryRepository(AppProperties properties) throws IOException {
        this.file = Path.of(properties.getDataDir()).resolve("history.json");
        load();
    }

    public synchronized void save(HistoryEntry entry) throws IOException {
        entries.add(0, entry); // most recent first
        persist();
    }

    public List<HistoryEntry> findAll() {
        return List.copyOf(entries);
    }

    public Optional<HistoryEntry> findById(String id) {
        return entries.stream().filter(e -> e.id().equals(id)).findFirst();
    }

    private void load() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(file)) {
            return;
        }
        HistoryEntry[] loaded = MAPPER.readValue(file.toFile(), HistoryEntry[].class);
        entries.addAll(List.of(loaded));
    }

    private void persist() throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
        MAPPER.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(file.toFile(), new ArrayList<>(entries));
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.repository;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.project.toolkit.api.config.AppProperties;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.SchemaRecord;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/** Pure file-based persistence for registered schemas: the in-memory index, the registry.json
 * backing file, and the on-disk storage of each uploaded XSD's bytes. No business rules here
 * (version derivation, id generation) -- that's {@link com.project.toolkit.api.service.SchemaService}. */
@Repository
public final class SchemaRepository {

    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();

    private final Map<String, SchemaRecord> schemas = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Path storageDir;
    private final Path registryFile;

    public SchemaRepository(AppProperties properties) throws IOException {
        Path dataDir = Path.of(properties.getDataDir());
        this.storageDir = dataDir.resolve("schemas");
        this.registryFile = dataDir.resolve("registry.json");
        Files.createDirectories(storageDir);
        load();
    }

    /** Copies the uploaded XSD's bytes to disk under {@code id} and returns the stored file name. */
    public String storeXsdFile(String id, InputStream content) throws IOException {
        String fileName = id + ".xsd";
        Files.copy(content, storageDir.resolve(fileName));
        return fileName;
    }

    public void save(SchemaRecord record) throws IOException {
        schemas.put(record.id(), record);
        persist();
    }

    public List<SchemaRecord> findAll() {
        return List.copyOf(schemas.values());
    }

    public Optional<SchemaRecord> findById(String id) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(schemas.get(id));
    }

    public Path resolveXsdPath(SchemaRecord record) {
        return resolveXsdPath(record.fileName());
    }

    public Path resolveXsdPath(String fileName) {
        return storageDir.resolve(fileName);
    }

    private void persist() throws IOException {
        MAPPER.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(registryFile.toFile(), List.copyOf(schemas.values()));
    }

    private void load() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(registryFile)) {
            return;
        }
        SchemaRecord[] records = MAPPER.readValue(registryFile.toFile(), SchemaRecord[].class);
        for (SchemaRecord r : records) {
            schemas.put(r.id(), r);
        }
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/security/PathSecurity.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.security;

import com.project.toolkit.api.config.AppProperties;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

/**
 * Two things stand between "the user types a path" and "the server reads/writes any file it can
 * see": resolving a server-supplied path only inside a configured allow-list ({@link #resolve}),
 * and extracting an uploaded ZIP without letting an entry's name escape the destination
 * directory via {@code ../} segments or an absolute path ({@link #extractZipSafely}, the
 * "zip-slip" vulnerability).
 */
@Component
public final class PathSecurity {

    private final List<Path> allowedBases;
    private final long maxExtractedBytes;

    public PathSecurity(AppProperties properties) {
        this.allowedBases = properties.allowedBaseFolderPaths();
        this.maxExtractedBytes = properties.getMaxUploadBytes();
    }

    /** Resolves a user-supplied path string, requiring the result to land inside one of the
     * configured allowed base folders. Throws {@link SecurityException} otherwise -- including
     * for a path that merely LOOKS like it escapes (resolved and normalized first, so
     * {@code ../../etc/passwd}-style traversal is caught regardless of how it's spelled). */
    public Path resolve(String userSuppliedPath) {
        if (allowedBases.isEmpty()) {
            throw new SecurityException("No server paths are allowed: app.allowed-base-folders is empty");
        }
        Path candidate = Path.of(userSuppliedPath).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        for (Path base : allowedBases) {
            if (candidate.equals(base) || candidate.startsWith(base)) {
                return candidate;
            }
        }
        throw new SecurityException("Path is outside the allowed server folders: " + userSuppliedPath);
    }

    public boolean isAllowed(Path path) {
        Path candidate = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        return allowedBases.stream().anyMatch(base -> candidate.equals(base) || candidate.startsWith(base));
    }

    /** Extracts every entry of a ZIP into {@code destDir}, rejecting any entry whose resolved
     * path would land outside {@code destDir} (zip-slip), and capping total DECOMPRESSED bytes
     * at {@code app.max-upload-bytes} -- a small, highly-compressible upload can expand to a
     * huge amount of disk/memory on extraction (a "zip bomb"), which the servlet container's own
     * multipart size limit does nothing to stop since that only caps the compressed upload. */
    public void extractZipSafely(InputStream zipData, Path destDir) throws IOException {
        Path destRoot = destDir.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Files.createDirectories(destRoot);
        long totalBytes = 0;
        try (ZipInputStream zis = new ZipInputStream(zipData)) {
            ZipEntry entry;
            while ((entry = zis.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                Path target = destRoot.resolve(entry.getName()).normalize();
                if (!target.startsWith(destRoot)) {
                    throw new SecurityException("Zip entry escapes destination directory: " + entry.getName());
                }
                if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                    Files.createDirectories(target);
                    continue;
                }
                if (target.getParent() != null) {
                    Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());
                }
                try (OutputStream out = Files.newOutputStream(target)) {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
                    int n;
                    while ((n = zis.read(buffer)) >= 0) {
                        totalBytes += n;
                        if (totalBytes > maxExtractedBytes) {
                            throw new SecurityException("Zip would extract to more than the " + maxExtractedBytes
                                    + "-byte limit (app.max-upload-bytes) -- rejected as a likely zip bomb");
                        }
                        out.write(buffer, 0, n);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.service;

import com.project.toolkit.api.dto.GenerateRequest;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.Job;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.SchemaRecord;
import com.project.toolkit.api.repository.JobFileRepository;
import com.project.toolkit.api.security.PathSecurity;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.ContentLevel;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateOptions;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateResult;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

import java.nio.file.Path;

/** The full orchestration behind {@code POST /api/generate}'s job: build the engine's
 * {@link GenerateOptions} from the request, wire up cancellation/progress against the job, run
 * {@link GenerateCommand}, and record what the job controller needs in {@code job.attributes}. */
@Service
public final class GenerateService {

    private final SchemaService schemaService;
    private final JobFileRepository jobFileRepository;
    private final PathSecurity pathSecurity;
    private final JobService jobService;

    public GenerateService(SchemaService schemaService, JobFileRepository jobFileRepository,
                            PathSecurity pathSecurity, JobService jobService) {
        this.schemaService = schemaService;
        this.jobFileRepository = jobFileRepository;
        this.pathSecurity = pathSecurity;
        this.jobService = jobService;
    }

    public GenerateResult runGenerate(Job job, SchemaRecord schema, GenerateRequest req) throws Exception {
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = schemaService.xsdPath(schema);
        opts.count = req.count() != null ? req.count() : 1000;
        if (req.level() != null) {
            ContentLevel.fromNumber(req.level()); // validate eagerly with the same error message as the CLI
            opts.level = req.level();
        }
        opts.size = req.size() != null ? req.size() : "mixed";
        opts.errorPercent = req.errorPercent() != null ? req.errorPercent() : 0;
        opts.errorTypes = req.errorTypes();
        opts.seed = req.seed() != null ? req.seed() : System.nanoTime();
        opts.threads = req.threads() != null ? req.threads() : Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();
        opts.output = "zip";
        if (req.profilePath() != null) {
            opts.profile = pathSecurity.resolve(req.profilePath());
        }

        Path jobDir = jobFileRepository.dirFor(job.id);
        Path zipPath = jobDir.resolve("output.zip");
        opts.out = zipPath;

        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(req.includeSupplement())) {
            if (schema.linkedSupplementId() == null) {
                throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "includeSupplement was requested but schema " + schema.id() + " has no linkedSupplementId");
            }
            SchemaRecord supplement = schemaService.get(schema.linkedSupplementId())
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                            "Linked supplement schema not found: " + schema.linkedSupplementId()));
            opts.supplement = schemaService.xsdPath(supplement);
        }

        opts.cancelled = () -> job.cancelRequested.get();
        opts.onFileDone = done -> jobService.updateProgress(job, Math.min(99, (int) (100.0 * done / opts.count)));

        GenerateResult result = GenerateCommand.run(opts);
        job.attributes.put("downloadPath", zipPath.toString());
        job.attributes.put("downloadContentType", "application/zip");
        job.attributes.put("downloadFileName", "generated.zip");
        // The zip (opts.output = "zip") only ever contains generated XMLs -- GenerateCommand
        // writes report.json/csv and manifest.json/csv as loose files beside it in this same
        // jobDir instead, exactly like an infer job's own report files, so GET
        // /api/jobs/{id}/report can read them the same way for both job types.
        job.attributes.put("reportJsonPath", jobDir.resolve("report.json").toString());
        job.attributes.put("reportCsvPath", jobDir.resolve("report.csv").toString());
        return result;
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/service/InferService.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.service;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.FileGroup;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.Job;
import com.project.toolkit.api.repository.JobFileRepository;
import com.project.toolkit.api.security.PathSecurity;
import com.project.toolkit.api.util.FileGrouper;
import com.project.toolkit.infer.InferCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.infer.InferOptions;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Runs the group-then-infer pipeline for one infer job: materialize the uploaded samples, group
 * them by message type (A-side of the API spec), then run the real engine's {@link InferCommand}
 * once per group so groups/review/decisions/register all have something to read. Each group's own
 * subset of files is copied into {@code jobDir/groups/<groupKey>/samples} so the engine (which
 * reads a whole directory) only ever sees that one message type.
 */
@Service
public final class InferService {

    public record GroupInferenceResult(FileGroup group, Path xsdPath, Path reviewJsonPath, Path reviewMdPath,
                                        int validSamples, int totalSamples) {
    }

    private final JobFileRepository jobFileRepository;
    private final PathSecurity pathSecurity;
    private final JobService jobService;

    public InferService(JobFileRepository jobFileRepository, PathSecurity pathSecurity, JobService jobService) {
        this.jobFileRepository = jobFileRepository;
        this.pathSecurity = pathSecurity;
        this.jobService = jobService;
    }

    /** Reads the uploaded zip/files into a short-lived staging directory, synchronously on the
     * request thread -- before the request completes and the servlet container is free to clean
     * up its multipart temp files out from under an async job that hasn't read them yet. Returns
     * null when the input came from {@code serverPath} instead, which reads straight off disk
     * later and has no such race. */
    public Path stageUpload(MultipartFile zip, MultipartFile[] files, String serverPath) throws IOException {
        int provided = (zip != null && !zip.isEmpty() ? 1 : 0) + (files != null && files.length > 0 ? 1 : 0)
                + (serverPath != null && !serverPath.isBlank() ? 1 : 0);
        if (provided != 1) {
            throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Provide exactly one of: zip, files, serverPath");
        }
        if (serverPath != null && !serverPath.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        Path staging = Files.createTempDirectory("infer-upload-");
        if (zip != null && !zip.isEmpty()) {
            pathSecurity.extractZipSafely(zip.getInputStream(), staging);
        } else {
            for (MultipartFile f : files) {
                Files.copy(f.getInputStream(), staging.resolve(Path.of(f.getOriginalFilename()).getFileName()));
            }
        }
        return staging;
    }

    /** The full orchestration behind {@code POST /api/infer}'s job: move the already-staged input
     * (or read it from {@code serverPath}) into place, group, infer each group, and record what
     * the job controller/other endpoints need in {@code job.attributes}. */
    public Object runInfer(Job job, Path stagedUpload, String serverPath,
                            Path baselineXsd, Integer maxSamples) throws IOException {
        Path jobDir = jobFileRepository.dirFor(job.id);
        Path samplesDir = jobDir.resolve("samples");
        Files.createDirectories(samplesDir);
        if (stagedUpload != null) {
            moveStagedInto(stagedUpload, samplesDir);
        } else {
            copyFromServerPath(serverPath, samplesDir);
        }

        FileGrouper.Result grouped = groupSamples(samplesDir);
        job.attributes.put("groups", grouped.groups());
        job.attributes.put("brokenFiles", grouped.brokenFiles());

        List<GroupInferenceResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
        int done = 0;
        for (FileGroup group : grouped.groups()) {
            if (job.cancelRequested.get()) {
                break;
            }
            results.add(inferGroup(jobDir, samplesDir, group, maxSamples, baselineXsd));
            jobService.updateProgress(job, Math.min(99, (int) (100.0 * ++done / Math.max(1, grouped.groups().size()))));
        }
        job.attributes.put("groupResults", results);

        if (results.size() == 1) {
            job.attributes.put("downloadPath", results.get(0).xsdPath().toString());
            job.attributes.put("downloadContentType", "application/xml");
            job.attributes.put("downloadFileName", "inferred.xsd");
            job.attributes.put("reportJsonPath", results.get(0).reviewJsonPath().toString());
        }
        return Map.of("groupCount", grouped.groups().size(), "brokenFileCount", grouped.brokenFiles().size());
    }

    private void moveStagedInto(Path staging, Path samplesDir) throws IOException {
        try (var list = Files.list(staging)) {
            for (Path p : list.toList()) {
                Files.move(p, samplesDir.resolve(p.getFileName()));
            }
        }
        Files.delete(staging);
    }

    private void copyFromServerPath(String serverPath, Path samplesDir) throws IOException {
        Path source = pathSecurity.resolve(serverPath);
        if (Files.isDirectory(source)) {
            try (var list = Files.list(source)) {
                for (Path p : list.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
                    Files.copy(p, samplesDir.resolve(p.getFileName()));
                }
            }
        } else {
            Files.copy(source, samplesDir.resolve(source.getFileName()));
        }
    }

    public FileGrouper.Result groupSamples(Path samplesDir) throws IOException {
        return FileGrouper.group(samplesDir);
    }

    public GroupInferenceResult inferGroup(Path jobDir, Path samplesDir, FileGroup group, Integer maxSamples,
                                            Path baselineXsd) throws IOException {
        Path groupDir = jobDir.resolve("groups").resolve(safeDirName(group.groupKey()));
        Path groupSamplesDir = groupDir.resolve("samples");
        Files.createDirectories(groupSamplesDir);

        List<String> fileNames = group.fileNames();
        if (maxSamples != null && maxSamples > 0 && fileNames.size() > maxSamples) {
            fileNames = fileNames.subList(0, maxSamples);
        }
        for (String fileName : fileNames) {
            Files.copy(samplesDir.resolve(fileName), groupSamplesDir.resolve(fileName));
        }

        InferOptions opts = new InferOptions();
        opts.xmlInput = groupSamplesDir;
        opts.outXsd = groupDir.resolve("inferred.xsd");
        opts.baselineXsd = baselineXsd;
        InferCommand.run(opts);

        Path reviewJson = groupDir.resolve("inferred_review.json");
        Path reviewMd = groupDir.resolve("inferred_review.md");
        int[] counts = revalidateGroup(opts.outXsd, groupSamplesDir);
        return new GroupInferenceResult(group, opts.outXsd, reviewJson, reviewMd, counts[0], counts[1]);
    }

    /** Re-validates a group's samples against its current XSD (used both right after inferring,
     * and again after decisions are recorded, to report a real, current validation count). */
    public int[] revalidateGroup(Path xsd, Path samplesDir) throws IOException {
        int valid = 0, total = 0;
        try (var files = Files.list(samplesDir)) {
            for (Path f : files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).toList()) {
                total++;
                if (com.project.toolkit.validate.XsdValidatorCache.validate(xsd, f).valid()) {
                    valid++;
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[]{valid, total};
    }

    private static String safeDirName(String groupKey) {
        return groupKey.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._#,-]", "_");
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/service/JobService.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.service;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.Job;
import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.JobStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.SseEmitter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Tracks every background job, runs its work on a shared pool, and fans out progress/completion
 * as both a pollable status (GET /api/jobs/{id}) and Server-Sent Events (GET /api/jobs/{id}/events). */
@Service
public final class JobService {

    private final Map<String, Job> jobs = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newCachedThreadPool();

    /** @param work receives the Job so it can check {@code cancelRequested} and update
     *             {@code progressPercent}/{@code attributes} as it runs; its return value
     *             becomes {@code job.result} on success. */
    public Job submit(String type, JobWork work) {
        Job job = new Job(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), type);
        jobs.put(job.id, job);
        executor.submit(() -> {
            job.status = JobStatus.RUNNING;
            job.emit(statusEvent(job));
            try {
                Object result = work.run(job);
                if (job.cancelRequested.get()) {
                    job.status = JobStatus.CANCELLED;
                } else {
                    job.result = result;
                    job.progressPercent = 100;
                    job.status = JobStatus.SUCCEEDED;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                job.status = JobStatus.FAILED;
                job.errorMessage = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : e.getClass().getSimpleName();
            }
            job.emit(statusEvent(job));
        });
        return job;
    }

    public Optional<Job> find(String id) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(jobs.get(id));
    }

    public boolean cancel(String id) {
        Job job = jobs.get(id);
        if (job == null || job.status == JobStatus.SUCCEEDED || job.status == JobStatus.FAILED) {
            return false;
        }
        job.cancelRequested.set(true);
        return true;
    }

    public void updateProgress(Job job, int percent) {
        job.progressPercent = percent;
        job.emit(statusEvent(job));
    }

    public SseEmitter subscribe(String id) {
        Job job = jobs.get(id);
        SseEmitter emitter = new SseEmitter(0L); // no timeout: a generate/infer run can take a while
        if (job == null) {
            emitter.completeWithError(new java.util.NoSuchElementException("No such job: " + id));
            return emitter;
        }
        java.util.function.Consumer<Map<String, Object>> listener = event -> {
            try {
                emitter.send(event);
                String status = String.valueOf(event.get("status"));
                if (JobStatus.SUCCEEDED.name().equals(status) || JobStatus.FAILED.name().equals(status)
                        || JobStatus.CANCELLED.name().equals(status)) {
                    emitter.complete();
                }
            } catch (IOException e) {
                emitter.completeWithError(e);
            }
        };
        job.eventListeners.add(listener);
        listener.accept(statusEvent(job)); // current state immediately, so a late subscriber isn't stuck waiting
        return emitter;
    }

    private Map<String, Object> statusEvent(Job job) {
        return Map.of(
                "jobId", job.id,
                "type", job.type,
                "status", job.status.name(),
                "progressPercent", job.progressPercent
        );
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface JobWork {
        Object run(Job job) throws Exception;
    }
}
