package com.project.toolkit.api.service;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.SchemaRecord;
import com.project.toolkit.api.repository.SchemaRepository;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.SchemaInfo;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Registered XSDs (GET /api/schemas, generate/infer by schemaId, history re-run): id generation,
 * version derivation from namespace, and orchestrating storage via {@link SchemaRepository}. */
@Service
public final class SchemaService {

    private static final Pattern VERSION_SUFFIX = Pattern.compile("(\\d{3}\\.\\d{2,3})$");

    private final SchemaRepository repository;

    public SchemaService(SchemaRepository repository) {
        this.repository = repository;
    }

    public SchemaRecord register(String name, InputStream xsdContent, String linkedSupplementId) throws IOException {
        String id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        String fileName = repository.storeXsdFile(id, xsdContent);
        Path dest = repository.resolveXsdPath(fileName);

        SchemaInfo info = SchemaInfo.read(dest);
        String version = deriveVersion(info.namespace);
        SchemaRecord record = new SchemaRecord(id, name, fileName, info.rootElementName, info.namespace, version, linkedSupplementId);
        repository.save(record);
        return record;
    }

    public List<SchemaRecord> list() {
        return repository.findAll();
    }

    public Optional<SchemaRecord> get(String id) {
        return repository.findById(id);
    }

    public Path xsdPath(SchemaRecord record) {
        return repository.resolveXsdPath(record);
    }

    private static String deriveVersion(String namespace) {
        Matcher m = VERSION_SUFFIX.matcher(namespace);
        return m.find() ? m.group(1) : null;
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api.util;

import com.project.toolkit.api.entity.FileGroup;

import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamConstants;
import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Groups a folder of sample XMLs by what message type they look like, so a mixed upload can be
 * inferred group-by-group rather than as one (likely nonsensical) merge. Peeks only the root
 * element and, when it has no namespace, its direct children's names -- not a full parse -- since
 * this only needs to decide "do these belong together", not infer structure.
 */
public final class FileGrouper {

    public record Result(List<FileGroup> groups, List<String> brokenFiles, List<String> unknownFiles) {
    }

    private FileGrouper() {
    }

    public static Result group(Path dir) throws IOException {
        XMLInputFactory factory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
        Map<String, List<String>> byKey = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Map<String, String[]> keyInfo = new HashMap<>(); // key -> [namespace, rootName, fingerprint]
        List<String> broken = new ArrayList<>();

        try (var files = Files.list(dir)) {
            List<Path> xmlFiles = files.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml")).sorted().toList();
            for (Path file : xmlFiles) {
                try {
                    Peek peek = peek(file, factory);
                    String fingerprint = peek.namespace.isEmpty() ? fingerprintOf(peek.childNames) : null;
                    String key = peek.namespace.isEmpty()
                            ? peek.rootName + "#" + fingerprint
                            : peek.namespace + ":" + peek.rootName;
                    byKey.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(file.getFileName().toString());
                    keyInfo.putIfAbsent(key, new String[]{peek.namespace, peek.rootName, fingerprint});
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    broken.add(file.getFileName().toString());
                }
            }
        }

        List<FileGroup> groups = new ArrayList<>();
        for (var entry : byKey.entrySet()) {
            String[] info = keyInfo.get(entry.getKey());
            groups.add(new FileGroup(entry.getKey(), info[0], info[1], info[2], entry.getValue()));
        }
        return new Result(groups, broken, List.of());
    }

    private record Peek(String namespace, String rootName, List<String> childNames) {
    }

    private static Peek peek(Path file, XMLInputFactory factory) throws Exception {
        try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
            XMLStreamReader reader = factory.createXMLStreamReader(in);
            String namespace = null;
            String rootName = null;
            List<String> childNames = new ArrayList<>();
            int depth = 0;
            while (reader.hasNext()) {
                int event = reader.next();
                if (event == XMLStreamConstants.START_ELEMENT) {
                    depth++;
                    if (depth == 1) {
                        namespace = reader.getNamespaceURI();
                        rootName = reader.getLocalName();
                    } else if (depth == 2) {
                        childNames.add(reader.getLocalName());
                    } else {
                        break; // only need the root and its direct children
                    }
                } else if (event == XMLStreamConstants.END_ELEMENT) {
                    depth--;
                }
            }
            reader.close();
            if (rootName == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("No root element found");
            }
            return new Peek(namespace == null ? "" : namespace, rootName, childNames);
        }
    }

    /** Sorted, deduplicated child names joined -- stable regardless of how many times each
     * child repeats or what order a particular sample happened to write them in. */
    private static String fingerprintOf(List<String> childNames) {
        List<String> distinct = new ArrayList<>(new TreeSet<>(childNames));
        return String.join(",", distinct);
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/main/java/com/project/toolkit/api/util/ReviewJsonFilter.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api.util;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Strips already-decided fields out of a review report's JSON text (the API spec's "apply
 * automatically next time" rule) without re-parsing it into objects, since the report is already
 * exactly the shape the caller wants. */
public final class ReviewJsonFilter {

    private ReviewJsonFilter() {
    }

    public static String filterOutDecidedPaths(String json, Map<String, String> existingDecisions) {
        String result = json;
        for (String decidedPath : existingDecisions.keySet()) {
            result = result.replaceAll(",?\\s*\\{[^{}]*\"path\":\"" + Pattern.quote(decidedPath) + "\"[^{}]*}", "");
        }
        return result;
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.client.TestRestTemplate;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
class GenerateJobFlowTest {

    @TempDir
    static Path dataDir;

    @LocalServerPort
    int port;

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("app.data-dir", () -> dataDir.toString());
        registry.add("app.allowed-base-folders", () -> dataDir.toString());
    }

    private static final Path SUPL009 = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_Extension_supl_009_001_11.xsd");

    @Test
    void generateJobRunsAndProducesADownloadableZipWithAReport() throws Exception {
        TestRestTemplate rest = new TestRestTemplate();
        String base = "http://localhost:" + port;

        String schemaId = registerSchema(rest, base);

        String body = """
                {"schemaId":"%s","count":5,"level":2,"seed":123}
                """.formatted(schemaId);
        HttpHeaders jsonHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
        jsonHeaders.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        ResponseEntity<String> genResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/generate",
                new HttpEntity<>(body, jsonHeaders), String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED, genResponse.getStatusCode());
        String jobId = genResponse.getBody().split("\"jobId\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];

        String status = waitForCompletion(rest, base, jobId);
        assertEquals("SUCCEEDED", status, "job should succeed");

        ResponseEntity<byte[]> download = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId + "/download", byte[].class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, download.getStatusCode());
        int xmlEntries = 0;
        int totalEntries = 0;
        try (ZipInputStream zis = new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(download.getBody()))) {
            var entry = zis.getNextEntry();
            while (entry != null) {
                totalEntries++;
                if (entry.getName().endsWith(".xml")) {
                    xmlEntries++;
                }
                assertFalse(entry.getName().startsWith("report.") || entry.getName().startsWith("manifest."),
                        "the downloaded zip should contain only XML documents, not " + entry.getName());
                entry = zis.getNextEntry();
            }
        }
        assertEquals(5, xmlEntries, "zip should contain the 5 requested XML files");
        assertEquals(5, totalEntries, "zip should contain nothing but the 5 XML files");

        ResponseEntity<String> report = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId + "/report?format=json", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, report.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(report.getBody().contains("\"seed\":123"), "report should echo the seed used:\n" + report.getBody());

        ResponseEntity<String> csvReport = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId + "/report?format=csv", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, csvReport.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(csvReport.getBody().contains("seed,123"));
    }

    @Test
    void cancellingAJobStopsItFromReportingSuccess() throws Exception {
        TestRestTemplate rest = new TestRestTemplate();
        String base = "http://localhost:" + port;
        String schemaId = registerSchema(rest, base);

        String body = """
                {"schemaId":"%s","count":2000,"level":3,"size":"large","seed":7,"threads":1}
                """.formatted(schemaId);
        HttpHeaders jsonHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
        jsonHeaders.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        ResponseEntity<String> genResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/generate",
                new HttpEntity<>(body, jsonHeaders), String.class);
        String jobId = genResponse.getBody().split("\"jobId\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];

        Thread.sleep(300); // let it start and queue a few files before cancelling
        ResponseEntity<String> cancelResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId + "/cancel", null, String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, cancelResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(cancelResponse.getBody().contains("\"cancelled\":true"));

        String status = waitForCompletion(rest, base, jobId);
        assertEquals("CANCELLED", status);
    }

    private String registerSchema(TestRestTemplate rest, String base) {
        MultiValueMap<String, Object> body = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        body.add("file", new FileSystemResource(SUPL009));
        body.add("name", "supl.009");
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA);
        ResponseEntity<String> response = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/schemas", new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.CREATED, response.getStatusCode());
        return response.getBody().split("\"id\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];
    }

    private String waitForCompletion(TestRestTemplate rest, String base, String jobId) throws InterruptedException {
        Instant deadline = Instant.now().plus(Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        while (Instant.now().isBefore(deadline)) {
            ResponseEntity<String> statusResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId, String.class);
            String body = statusResponse.getBody();
            if (body.contains("\"SUCCEEDED\"") || body.contains("\"FAILED\"") || body.contains("\"CANCELLED\"")) {
                if (body.contains("\"SUCCEEDED\"")) return "SUCCEEDED";
                if (body.contains("\"FAILED\"")) return "FAILED: " + body;
                return "CANCELLED";
            }
            Thread.sleep(100);
        }
        return "TIMEOUT";
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;

class HistoryTest {

    @TempDir
    static Path dataDir;

    @LocalServerPort
    int port;

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("app.data-dir", () -> dataDir.toString());
        registry.add("app.allowed-base-folders", () -> dataDir.toString());
    }

    private static final Path SUPL009 = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_Extension_supl_009_001_11.xsd");

    @Test
    void historyRecordsAGenerateRunAndRerunCreatesANewJob() throws InterruptedException {
        TestRestTemplate rest = new TestRestTemplate();
        String base = "http://localhost:" + port;

        MultiValueMap<String, Object> body = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        body.add("file", new FileSystemResource(SUPL009));
        body.add("name", "supl.009-history-test");
        HttpHeaders multipartHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
        multipartHeaders.setContentType(MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA);
        ResponseEntity<String> schemaResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/schemas", new HttpEntity<>(body, multipartHeaders), String.class);
        String schemaId = schemaResponse.getBody().split("\"id\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];

        String genBody = """
                {"schemaId":"%s","count":3,"level":1,"seed":55}
                """.formatted(schemaId);
        HttpHeaders jsonHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
        jsonHeaders.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        ResponseEntity<String> genResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/generate", new HttpEntity<>(genBody, jsonHeaders), String.class);
        String firstJobId = genResponse.getBody().split("\"jobId\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];
        waitForCompletion(rest, base, firstJobId);

        ResponseEntity<String> historyResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/history", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, historyResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(historyResponse.getBody().contains(firstJobId), "history should list the run we just made:\n" + historyResponse.getBody());
        String historyId = historyResponse.getBody().split("\"id\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];

        ResponseEntity<String> rerunResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/history/" + historyId + "/rerun", null, String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED, rerunResponse.getStatusCode());
        String secondJobId = rerunResponse.getBody().split("\"jobId\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];
        assertNotEquals(firstJobId, secondJobId, "rerun should create a distinct new job");
        waitForCompletion(rest, base, secondJobId);
    }

    private void waitForCompletion(TestRestTemplate rest, String base, String jobId) throws InterruptedException {
        Instant deadline = Instant.now().plus(Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        while (Instant.now().isBefore(deadline)) {
            String body = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId, String.class).getBody();
            if (body.contains("\"SUCCEEDED\"") || body.contains("\"FAILED\"")) {
                return;
            }
            Thread.sleep(100);
        }
        fail("job " + jobId + " did not finish in time");
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api;

import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateCommand;
import com.project.toolkit.generate.GenerateOptions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.client.TestRestTemplate;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
class InferJobFlowTest {

    @TempDir
    static Path dataDir;

    @LocalServerPort
    int port;

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("app.data-dir", () -> dataDir.toString());
        registry.add("app.allowed-base-folders", () -> dataDir.toString());
    }

    private static final Path SUPL009 = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_Extension_supl_009_001_11.xsd");

    @Test
    void inferJobGroupsReviewsAndRegistersFromAZipUpload(@TempDir Path tempDir) throws Exception {
        Path samplesDir = tempDir.resolve("samples");
        GenerateOptions opts = new GenerateOptions();
        opts.xsd = SUPL009;
        opts.out = samplesDir;
        opts.count = 10;
        opts.level = 2;
        opts.seed = 1;
        GenerateCommand.run(opts);

        Path zipFile = tempDir.resolve("samples.zip");
        try (var zos = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(zipFile));
             Stream<Path> files = Files.list(samplesDir).filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".xml"))) {
            for (Path f : files.toList()) {
                zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(f.getFileName().toString()));
                zos.write(Files.readAllBytes(f));
                zos.closeEntry();
            }
        }

        TestRestTemplate rest = new TestRestTemplate();
        String base = "http://localhost:" + port;

        MultiValueMap<String, Object> body = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        body.add("zip", new FileSystemResource(zipFile));
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA);
        ResponseEntity<String> inferResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/infer", new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.ACCEPTED, inferResponse.getStatusCode());
        String jobId = inferResponse.getBody().split("\"jobId\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];

        assertEquals("SUCCEEDED", waitForCompletion(rest, base, jobId));

        ResponseEntity<String> groupsResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/infer/" + jobId + "/groups", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, groupsResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(groupsResponse.getBody().contains("\"fileNames\""), "groups response:\n" + groupsResponse.getBody());
        assertTrue(groupsResponse.getBody().contains("DTCCCAPASD1") || groupsResponse.getBody().contains("rootElementName"),
                "groups response should identify the root element:\n" + groupsResponse.getBody());

        ResponseEntity<String> reviewResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/infer/" + jobId + "/review", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, reviewResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(reviewResponse.getBody().contains("needsReview"), "review response:\n" + reviewResponse.getBody());

        String decisionsBody = """
                {"decisions":{"Document/DTCCCAPASD1":"accept"}}
                """;
        HttpHeaders jsonHeaders = new HttpHeaders();
        jsonHeaders.setContentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
        ResponseEntity<String> decisionsResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/infer/" + jobId + "/decisions",
                new HttpEntity<>(decisionsBody, jsonHeaders), String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, decisionsResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(decisionsResponse.getBody().contains("\"validSamples\""), decisionsResponse.getBody());

        ResponseEntity<String> registerResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/infer/" + jobId + "/register?name=inferred-supl009",
                null, String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.CREATED, registerResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(registerResponse.getBody().contains("\"name\":\"inferred-supl009\""));

        // Decision should now be remembered and filtered out of a fresh review read for the
        // same group (the "apply automatically next time" rule).
        ResponseEntity<String> reviewAfter = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/infer/" + jobId + "/review", String.class);
        assertFalse(reviewAfter.getBody().contains("\"Document/DTCCCAPASD1\""),
                "a decided-on field should be filtered out of the next review read:\n" + reviewAfter.getBody());
    }

    private String waitForCompletion(TestRestTemplate rest, String base, String jobId) throws InterruptedException {
        Instant deadline = Instant.now().plus(Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        while (Instant.now().isBefore(deadline)) {
            ResponseEntity<String> statusResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/jobs/" + jobId, String.class);
            String responseBody = statusResponse.getBody();
            if (responseBody.contains("\"SUCCEEDED\"")) return "SUCCEEDED";
            if (responseBody.contains("\"FAILED\"")) return "FAILED: " + responseBody;
            if (responseBody.contains("\"CANCELLED\"")) return "CANCELLED";
            Thread.sleep(100);
        }
        return "TIMEOUT";
    }
}

package com.project.toolkit.api;

import com.project.toolkit.api.config.AppProperties;
import com.project.toolkit.api.security.PathSecurity;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class PathSecurityTest {

    @Test
    void rejectsAServerPathOutsideTheAllowedBaseFolders(@TempDir Path allowedDir, @TempDir Path otherDir) throws Exception {
        AppProperties props = new AppProperties();
        props.setAllowedBaseFolders(List.of(allowedDir.toString()));
        PathSecurity security = new PathSecurity(props);

        Path insideFile = allowedDir.resolve("ok.xml");
        Files.writeString(insideFile, "<a/>");
        assertEquals(insideFile.toAbsolutePath().normalize(), security.resolve(insideFile.toString()));

        Path outsideFile = otherDir.resolve("secret.xml");
        Files.writeString(outsideFile, "<a/>");
        assertThrows(SecurityException.class, () -> security.resolve(outsideFile.toString()));
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsDotDotTraversalEvenWhenSpelledToLookLikeItStaysInside(@TempDir Path allowedDir) throws Exception {
        AppProperties props = new AppProperties();
        props.setAllowedBaseFolders(List.of(allowedDir.resolve("sandbox").toString()));
        Files.createDirectories(allowedDir.resolve("sandbox"));
        PathSecurity security = new PathSecurity(props);

        String traversal = allowedDir.resolve("sandbox").resolve("..").resolve("outside.xml").toString();
        assertThrows(SecurityException.class, () -> security.resolve(traversal));
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsAZipEntryThatEscapesTheDestinationDirectory(@TempDir Path allowedDir, @TempDir Path destDir) throws Exception {
        AppProperties props = new AppProperties();
        props.setAllowedBaseFolders(List.of(allowedDir.toString()));
        PathSecurity security = new PathSecurity(props);

        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (ZipOutputStream zos = new ZipOutputStream(bos)) {
            zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("../../evil.xml"));
            zos.write("<a/>".getBytes());
            zos.closeEntry();
        }

        SecurityException ex = assertThrows(SecurityException.class, () ->
                security.extractZipSafely(new ByteArrayInputStream(bos.toByteArray()), destDir));
        assertTrue(ex.getMessage().contains("escapes"));
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsAZipThatWouldExtractPastTheConfiguredByteLimit(@TempDir Path allowedDir, @TempDir Path destDir) throws Exception {
        AppProperties props = new AppProperties();
        props.setAllowedBaseFolders(List.of(allowedDir.toString()));
        props.setMaxUploadBytes(1000); // tiny limit so a normal-looking entry still trips it
        PathSecurity security = new PathSecurity(props);

        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (ZipOutputStream zos = new ZipOutputStream(bos)) {
            zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("big.xml"));
            zos.write("x".repeat(5000).getBytes());
            zos.closeEntry();
        }

        SecurityException ex = assertThrows(SecurityException.class, () ->
                security.extractZipSafely(new ByteArrayInputStream(bos.toByteArray()), destDir));
        assertTrue(ex.getMessage().contains("zip bomb"));
    }

    @Test
    void extractsALegitimateZipNormally(@TempDir Path allowedDir, @TempDir Path destDir) throws Exception {
        AppProperties props = new AppProperties();
        props.setAllowedBaseFolders(List.of(allowedDir.toString()));
        PathSecurity security = new PathSecurity(props);

        ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (ZipOutputStream zos = new ZipOutputStream(bos)) {
            zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("sample1.xml"));
            zos.write("<a/>".getBytes());
            zos.closeEntry();
            zos.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("subdir/sample2.xml"));
            zos.write("<b/>".getBytes());
            zos.closeEntry();
        }

        security.extractZipSafely(new ByteArrayInputStream(bos.toByteArray()), destDir);
        assertTrue(Files.exists(destDir.resolve("sample1.xml")));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(destDir.resolve("subdir/sample2.xml")));
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-api/src/test/java/com/project/toolkit/api/SchemaControllerTest.java ===
package com.project.toolkit.api;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.client.TestRestTemplate;
import org.springframework.boot.test.web.server.LocalServerPort;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;
import org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap;
import org.springframework.util.MultiValueMap;

import java.nio.file.Path;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
class SchemaControllerTest {

    @TempDir
    static Path dataDir;

    @LocalServerPort
    int port;

    @DynamicPropertySource
    static void props(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {
        registry.add("app.data-dir", () -> dataDir.toString());
        registry.add("app.allowed-base-folders", () -> dataDir.toString());
    }

    private static final Path SEEV035 = Path.of("..", "xsd", "SR_2025_Corporate_Action_CAPA_seev_035_001_16.xsd");

    @Test
    void registersListsAndScansASchema() {
        TestRestTemplate rest = new TestRestTemplate();
        String base = "http://localhost:" + port;

        MultiValueMap<String, Object> body = new LinkedMultiValueMap<>();
        body.add("file", new FileSystemResource(SEEV035));
        body.add("name", "seev.035");
        HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
        headers.setContentType(MediaType.MULTIPART_FORM_DATA);
        ResponseEntity<String> registerResponse = rest.postForEntity(base + "/api/schemas",
                new HttpEntity<>(body, headers), String.class);

        assertEquals(HttpStatus.CREATED, registerResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(registerResponse.getBody().contains("\"rootElementName\":\"Document\""));
        assertTrue(registerResponse.getBody().contains("seev.035.001.16"));

        String id = registerResponse.getBody().split("\"id\":\"")[1].split("\"")[0];

        ResponseEntity<String> listResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/schemas", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, listResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(listResponse.getBody().contains(id));

        ResponseEntity<String> scanResponse = rest.getForEntity(base + "/api/schemas/" + id + "/scan", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.OK, scanResponse.getStatusCode());
        assertTrue(scanResponse.getBody().contains("\"requiredCount\":136"), "scan result should match the real schema:\n" + scanResponse.getBody());
        assertTrue(scanResponse.getBody().contains("\"finiteRepeatCount\":0"));
    }

    @Test
    void scanOfUnknownSchemaReturns404() {
        TestRestTemplate rest = new TestRestTemplate();
        ResponseEntity<String> response = rest.getForEntity(
                "http://localhost:" + port + "/api/schemas/does-not-exist/scan", String.class);
        assertEquals(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, response.getStatusCode());
    }
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/api/client.ts ===
import type {
  SchemaRecord,
  SchemaScanResult,
  JobStatusResponse,
  GenerateRequest,
  GenerateReport,
  InferGroupsResponse,
  ReviewResponse,
  HistoryEntry,
} from './types'

const BASE = '/api'

async function asJson<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  if (!response.ok) {
    let message = `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`
    try {
      const body = await response.text()
      if (body) message = body
    } catch {
      // keep the status-line message
    }
    throw new Error(message)
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>
}

export const api = {
  listSchemas: (): Promise<SchemaRecord[]> => fetch(`${BASE}/schemas`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  uploadSchema: (file: File, name?: string, linkedSupplementId?: string): Promise<SchemaRecord> => {
    const form = new FormData()
    form.append('file', file)
    if (name) form.append('name', name)
    if (linkedSupplementId) form.append('linkedSupplementId', linkedSupplementId)
    return fetch(`${BASE}/schemas`, { method: 'POST', body: form }).then((r) => asJson(r))
  },

  scanSchema: (id: string): Promise<SchemaScanResult> => fetch(`${BASE}/schemas/${id}/scan`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  schemaDownloadUrl: (id: string): string => `${BASE}/schemas/${id}/download`,

  generate: (req: GenerateRequest): Promise<{ jobId: string }> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/generate`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(req),
    }).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  jobStatus: (jobId: string): Promise<JobStatusResponse> => fetch(`${BASE}/jobs/${jobId}`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  cancelJob: (jobId: string): Promise<{ jobId: string; cancelled: boolean }> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/jobs/${jobId}/cancel`, { method: 'POST' }).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  jobDownloadUrl: (jobId: string): string => `${BASE}/jobs/${jobId}/download`,

  jobReport: (jobId: string, format: 'json' | 'csv'): Promise<string> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/jobs/${jobId}/report?format=${format}`).then((r) => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.status} ${r.statusText}`)
      return r.text()
    }),

  jobReportJson: (jobId: string): Promise<GenerateReport> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/jobs/${jobId}/report?format=json`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  jobEventsUrl: (jobId: string): string => `${BASE}/jobs/${jobId}/events`,

  inferFromZip: (zip: File, opts: { baselineSchemaId?: string; maxSamples?: number } = {}): Promise<{ jobId: string }> => {
    const form = new FormData()
    form.append('zip', zip)
    if (opts.baselineSchemaId) form.append('baselineSchemaId', opts.baselineSchemaId)
    if (opts.maxSamples) form.append('maxSamples', String(opts.maxSamples))
    return fetch(`${BASE}/infer`, { method: 'POST', body: form }).then((r) => asJson(r))
  },

  inferFromFiles: (files: File[], opts: { baselineSchemaId?: string; maxSamples?: number } = {}): Promise<{ jobId: string }> => {
    const form = new FormData()
    files.forEach((f) => form.append('files', f))
    if (opts.baselineSchemaId) form.append('baselineSchemaId', opts.baselineSchemaId)
    if (opts.maxSamples) form.append('maxSamples', String(opts.maxSamples))
    return fetch(`${BASE}/infer`, { method: 'POST', body: form }).then((r) => asJson(r))
  },

  inferFromServerPath: (serverPath: string, opts: { baselineSchemaId?: string; maxSamples?: number } = {}): Promise<{ jobId: string }> => {
    const form = new FormData()
    form.append('serverPath', serverPath)
    if (opts.baselineSchemaId) form.append('baselineSchemaId', opts.baselineSchemaId)
    if (opts.maxSamples) form.append('maxSamples', String(opts.maxSamples))
    return fetch(`${BASE}/infer`, { method: 'POST', body: form }).then((r) => asJson(r))
  },

  inferGroups: (jobId: string): Promise<InferGroupsResponse> => fetch(`${BASE}/infer/${jobId}/groups`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  inferXsdUrl: (jobId: string, group: string): string => `${BASE}/infer/${jobId}/xsd?group=${encodeURIComponent(group)}`,

  inferReview: (jobId: string, group?: string): Promise<ReviewResponse> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/infer/${jobId}/review${group ? `?group=${encodeURIComponent(group)}` : ''}`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  inferDecisions: (
    jobId: string,
    group: string,
    decisions: Record<string, string>,
  ): Promise<{ group: string; validSamples: number; totalSamples: number; note: string }> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/infer/${jobId}/decisions`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ group, decisions }),
    }).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  inferRegister: (jobId: string, group: string, name?: string): Promise<SchemaRecord> => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ group })
    if (name) params.set('name', name)
    return fetch(`${BASE}/infer/${jobId}/register?${params}`, { method: 'POST' }).then((r) => asJson(r))
  },

  history: (): Promise<HistoryEntry[]> => fetch(`${BASE}/history`).then((r) => asJson(r)),

  rerun: (historyId: string): Promise<{ jobId: string }> =>
    fetch(`${BASE}/history/${historyId}/rerun`, { method: 'POST' }).then((r) => asJson(r)),
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen, fireEvent, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
import SchemaSelector from './SchemaSelector'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import type { SchemaRecord } from '../api/types'

vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  api: {
    listSchemas: vi.fn(),
    uploadSchema: vi.fn(),
  },
}))

const SCHEMAS: SchemaRecord[] = [
  { id: 'id-1', name: 'seev.035', fileName: 'id-1.xsd', rootElementName: 'Document', namespace: 'urn:ns:seev035', version: '001.16', linkedSupplementId: null },
  { id: 'id-2', name: 'supl.009', fileName: 'id-2.xsd', rootElementName: 'Document', namespace: 'urn:ns:supl009', version: '001.11', linkedSupplementId: null },
]

describe('SchemaSelector', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.mocked(api.listSchemas).mockResolvedValue(SCHEMAS)
  })

  it('lists registered schemas and reports the selection', async () => {
    const onChange = vi.fn()
    render(<SchemaSelector value="" onChange={onChange} />)

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/seev\.035/)).toBeInTheDocument())

    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('XSD'), { target: { value: 'id-2' } })

    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id-2', SCHEMAS[1])
  })

  it('shows an error message if the schema list fails to load', async () => {
    vi.mocked(api.listSchemas).mockRejectedValue(new Error('network down'))
    render(<SchemaSelector value="" onChange={vi.fn()} />)

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByText(/network down/)).toBeInTheDocument())
  })
})

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/components/SchemaSelector.tsx ===
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import type { SchemaRecord } from '../api/types'

interface Props {
  value: string
  onChange: (schemaId: string, schema: SchemaRecord | null) => void
}

/** Pick a schema already in the registry, or upload a new XSD right from here -- used by both
 * the Generate and Create XSD pages (C1.1's "Select XSD (from registry, or upload)"). */
export default function SchemaSelector({ value, onChange }: Props) {
  const [schemas, setSchemas] = useState<SchemaRecord[]>([])
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    refresh()
  }, [])

  function refresh() {
    api
      .listSchemas()
      .then(setSchemas)
      .catch((e) => setError(String(e)))
  }

  function handleSelect(id: string) {
    const schema = schemas.find((s) => s.id === id) ?? null
    onChange(id, schema)
  }

  async function handleUpload(file: File) {
    setUploading(true)
    setError(null)
    try {
      const record = await api.uploadSchema(file)
      setSchemas((prev) => [...prev, record])
      onChange(record.id, record)
    } catch (e) {
      setError(String(e))
    } finally {
      setUploading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="field">
      <label htmlFor="schema-select">XSD</label>
      <select id="schema-select" value={value} onChange={(e) => handleSelect(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="">-- select a registered schema --</option>
        {schemas.map((s) => (
          <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
            {s.name} {s.version ? `(${s.version})` : ''}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
      <div className="btn-row">
        <label className="muted" style={{ cursor: uploading ? 'default' : 'pointer' }}>
          <input
            type="file"
            accept=".xsd"
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
            disabled={uploading}
            onChange={(e) => {
              const file = e.target.files?.[0]
              if (file) handleUpload(file)
              e.target.value = ''
            }}
          />
          <span style={{ textDecoration: 'underline' }}>{uploading ? 'Uploading...' : 'or upload a new XSD'}</span>
        </label>
      </div>
      {error && <div className="error-text">{error}</div>}
    </div>
  )
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/components/ui/FileDropzone.tsx ===
import { useRef, useState } from 'react'

interface Props {
  files: File[]
  onFilesChange: (files: File[]) => void
  accept: string[]
  multiple?: boolean
  allowFolderPick?: boolean
  label: string
  hint?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`
}

function matchesAccept(fileName: string, accept: string[]): boolean {
  const lower = fileName.toLowerCase()
  return accept.some((ext) => lower.endsWith(ext.toLowerCase()))
}

/** A drag-and-drop file picker: drop files or browse for them, see what's selected (name, size,
 * remove individually or clear all), and get a clear message about anything rejected for not
 * matching the accepted extension(s). Used for both "upload XML files" and "upload a ZIP". */
export default function FileDropzone({
  files,
  onFilesChange,
  accept,
  multiple = true,
  allowFolderPick = false,
  label,
  hint,
  disabled = false,
}: Props) {
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false)
  const [rejected, setRejected] = useState<string[]>([])
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)
  const folderInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  function ingest(incoming: File[]) {
    const accepted = incoming.filter((f) => matchesAccept(f.name, accept))
    const bad = incoming.filter((f) => !matchesAccept(f.name, accept)).map((f) => f.name)
    setRejected(bad)

    if (!multiple) {
      onFilesChange(accepted.slice(0, 1))
      return
    }
    const key = (f: File) => `${f.name}:${f.size}:${f.lastModified}`
    const existingKeys = new Set(files.map(key))
    const merged = [...files, ...accepted.filter((f) => !existingKeys.has(key(f)))]
    onFilesChange(merged)
  }

  function handleDrop(e: React.DragEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setDragOver(false)
    if (disabled) return
    ingest(Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files))
  }

  function removeFile(index: number) {
    onFilesChange(files.filter((_, i) => i !== index))
  }

  const totalSize = files.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.size, 0)

  return (
    <div className="dropzone-wrap">
      <div
        className={`dropzone${dragOver ? ' dropzone-over' : ''}${disabled ? ' dropzone-disabled' : ''}`}
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault()
          if (!disabled) setDragOver(true)
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
        onDrop={handleDrop}
      >
        <svg width="28" height="28" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" className="dropzone-icon">
          <path
            d="M12 15V4m0 0L8 8m4-4l4 4M5 16v2a2 2 0 002 2h10a2 2 0 002-2v-2"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.6"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
        </svg>
        <div className="dropzone-text">
          <strong>{label}</strong>
          <span>Drag and drop here, or</span>
        </div>
        <div className="btn-row" style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()} disabled={disabled}>
            Browse files
          </button>
          {allowFolderPick && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => folderInputRef.current?.click()} disabled={disabled}>
              Choose a folder
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {hint && <div className="hint">{hint}</div>}
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="file"
          multiple={multiple}
          accept={accept.join(',')}
          style={{ display: 'none' }}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(e) => {
            if (e.target.files) ingest(Array.from(e.target.files))
            e.target.value = ''
          }}
        />
        {allowFolderPick && (
          <input
            ref={folderInputRef}
            type="file"
            multiple
            // @ts-expect-error webkitdirectory isn't in the TS DOM lib yet
            webkitdirectory="true"
            style={{ display: 'none' }}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (e.target.files) ingest(Array.from(e.target.files))
              e.target.value = ''
            }}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {rejected.length > 0 && (
        <div className="error-text" style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
          Skipped {rejected.length} file(s) not matching {accept.join(', ')}: {rejected.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}
          {rejected.length > 5 ? '...' : ''}
        </div>
      )}

      {files.length > 0 && (
        <div className="file-list">
          <div className="file-list-header">
            <span>
              {files.length} file{files.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected · {formatSize(totalSize)} total
            </span>
            <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={() => onFilesChange([])}>
              Clear all
            </button>
          </div>
          <ul>
            {files.slice(0, 50).map((f, i) => (
              <li key={`${f.name}:${f.size}:${f.lastModified}`} className="file-chip">
                <span className="file-chip-name">{f.name}</span>
                <span className="file-chip-size">{formatSize(f.size)}</span>
                <span className="file-chip-remove" role="button" aria-label={`Remove ${f.name}`} onClick={() => removeFile(i)}>
                  ×
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {files.length > 50 && <div className="muted">...and {files.length - 50} more</div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

export interface MultiOption {
  value: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  disabledReason?: string
}

interface Props {
  id?: string
  options: MultiOption[]
  selected: string[]
  onChange: (next: string[]) => void
  placeholder?: string
  searchable?: boolean
}

/** A searchable multi-select dropdown: a checklist panel (filterable, with Select all / Clear
 * all) to pick several values, with the current selection shown as removable tag chips in the
 * trigger itself, plus a running count of how many are selected. */
export default function MultiSelectTags({
  id,
  options,
  selected,
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'Select...',
  searchable = true,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function onDocClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setOpen(false)
        setQuery('')
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick)
  }, [])

  function toggle(opt: MultiOption) {
    if (opt.disabled) return
    onChange(selected.includes(opt.value) ? selected.filter((v) => v !== opt.value) : [...selected, opt.value])
  }

  function remove(value: string, e: React.MouseEvent) {
    e.stopPropagation()
    onChange(selected.filter((v) => v !== value))
  }

  function selectAll() {
    onChange(options.filter((o) => !o.disabled).map((o) => o.value))
  }

  function clearAll() {
    onChange([])
  }

  const selectedOptions = selected.map((v) => options.find((o) => o.value === v)).filter((o): o is MultiOption => !!o)
  const filtered = query.trim()
    ? options.filter(
        (o) =>
          o.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()) ||
          o.description?.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()),
      )
    : options

  return (
    <div className="ms-root" ref={rootRef} id={id}>
      <div className="ms-trigger" onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
        {selectedOptions.length === 0 ? (
          <span className="ss-placeholder">{placeholder}</span>
        ) : (
          <div className="ms-tags">
            {selectedOptions.map((opt) => (
              <span className="tag" key={opt.value}>
                {opt.label}
                <span className="tag-remove" role="button" aria-label={`Remove ${opt.label}`} onClick={(e) => remove(opt.value, e)}>
                  ×
                </span>
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <span className="ms-trigger-right">
          {selectedOptions.length > 0 && <span className="ms-count">{selectedOptions.length} selected</span>}
          <svg className="ss-chevron" width="10" height="6" viewBox="0 0 10 6" fill="none">
            <path d="M1 1L5 5L9 1" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </svg>
        </span>
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div className="ss-menu">
          <div className="ms-menu-actions">
            <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={selectAll} disabled={options.every((o) => o.disabled)}>
              Select all
            </button>
            <span className="ms-menu-actions-sep">·</span>
            <button type="button" className="link-button" onClick={clearAll} disabled={selected.length === 0}>
              Clear all
            </button>
          </div>
          {searchable && (
            <input
              autoFocus
              className="ss-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search..."
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          )}
          <div className="ss-options">
            {filtered.length === 0 && <div className="ss-empty">No matches</div>}
            {filtered.map((opt) => (
              <label
                key={opt.value}
                className={`ms-option${opt.disabled ? ' ms-option-disabled' : ''}`}
                title={opt.disabled ? opt.disabledReason : undefined}
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selected.includes(opt.value)}
                  disabled={opt.disabled}
                  onChange={() => toggle(opt)}
                />
                <div>
                  <div className="ss-option-label">{opt.label}</div>
                  {opt.description && <div className="ss-option-desc">{opt.description}</div>}
                  {opt.disabled && opt.disabledReason && <div className="ss-option-desc">{opt.disabledReason}</div>}
                </div>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

export interface SelectOption {
  value: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  disabledReason?: string
}

interface Props {
  id?: string
  options: SelectOption[]
  value: string
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  placeholder?: string
  searchable?: boolean
  clearable?: boolean
  onClear?: () => void
  disabled?: boolean
}

/** A styled single-select combobox: click to open, type to filter, click an option to pick it.
 * Used anywhere a plain <select> isn't expressive enough (option descriptions, disabled-with-reason,
 * search over many registered schemas). */
export default function SearchableSelect({
  id,
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'Select...',
  searchable = true,
  clearable = false,
  onClear,
  disabled = false,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function onDocClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (rootRef.current && !rootRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setOpen(false)
        setQuery('')
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onDocClick)
  }, [])

  const selected = options.find((o) => o.value === value) ?? null
  const filtered = query.trim()
    ? options.filter((o) => o.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()))
    : options

  function pick(opt: SelectOption) {
    if (opt.disabled) return
    onChange(opt.value)
    setOpen(false)
    setQuery('')
  }

  return (
    <div className={`ss-root${disabled ? ' ss-disabled' : ''}`} ref={rootRef} id={id}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={`ss-trigger${open ? ' ss-trigger-open' : ''}`}
        onClick={() => !disabled && setOpen((o) => !o)}
        disabled={disabled}
      >
        <span className={selected ? 'ss-value' : 'ss-placeholder'}>{selected ? selected.label : placeholder}</span>
        <span className="ss-trigger-icons">
          {clearable && selected && (
            <span
              className="ss-clear"
              role="button"
              aria-label="Clear selection"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation()
                onClear?.()
                setOpen(false)
              }}
            >
              ×
            </span>
          )}
          <svg className="ss-chevron" width="10" height="6" viewBox="0 0 10 6" fill="none">
            <path d="M1 1L5 5L9 1" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
          </svg>
        </span>
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="ss-menu">
          {searchable && (
            <input
              autoFocus
              className="ss-search"
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search..."
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            />
          )}
          <div className="ss-options">
            {filtered.length === 0 && <div className="ss-empty">No matches</div>}
            {filtered.map((opt) => (
              <div
                key={opt.value}
                className={`ss-option${opt.value === value ? ' ss-option-selected' : ''}${opt.disabled ? ' ss-option-disabled' : ''}`}
                title={opt.disabled ? opt.disabledReason : undefined}
                onClick={() => pick(opt)}
              >
                <div className="ss-option-label">{opt.label}</div>
                {opt.description && <div className="ss-option-desc">{opt.description}</div>}
                {opt.disabled && opt.disabledReason && <div className="ss-option-desc">{opt.disabledReason}</div>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/lib/browserXmlGrouper.test.ts ===
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'
import { groupFilesInBrowser, smartSample } from './browserXmlGrouper'

function xmlFile(name: string, content: string): File {
  return new File([content], name, { type: 'application/xml' })
}

describe('groupFilesInBrowser', () => {
  it('groups files by namespace + root element', async () => {
    const files = [
      xmlFile('a.xml', '<Document xmlns="urn:ns:a"><Foo/></Document>'),
      xmlFile('b.xml', '<Document xmlns="urn:ns:a"><Foo/></Document>'),
      xmlFile('c.xml', '<Document xmlns="urn:ns:b"><Bar/></Document>'),
    ]

    const result = await groupFilesInBrowser(files)

    expect(result.groups).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(result.brokenFiles).toHaveLength(0)
    const nsA = result.groups.find((g) => g.namespace === 'urn:ns:a')
    expect(nsA?.files.map((f) => f.name).sort()).toEqual(['a.xml', 'b.xml'])
  })

  it('uses a child-name fingerprint to separate same-named-root files with no namespace', async () => {
    const files = [
      xmlFile('a.xml', '<Root><Foo/><Bar/></Root>'),
      xmlFile('b.xml', '<Root><Baz/></Root>'),
    ]

    const result = await groupFilesInBrowser(files)

    expect(result.groups).toHaveLength(2)
    expect(result.groups.every((g) => g.namespace === '')).toBe(true)
    expect(result.groups.every((g) => g.fingerprint !== null)).toBe(true)
  })

  it('puts unparseable files in brokenFiles instead of throwing', async () => {
    const files = [xmlFile('good.xml', '<Root/>'), xmlFile('bad.xml', '<Root><unterminated>')]

    const result = await groupFilesInBrowser(files)

    expect(result.groups).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(result.brokenFiles.map((f) => f.name)).toEqual(['bad.xml'])
  })
})

describe('smartSample', () => {
  it('returns every file when under the limit', () => {
    const files = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => xmlFile(`${i}.xml`, '<a/>'))
    expect(smartSample(files, 200)).toHaveLength(5)
  })

  it('caps at maxSamples and spreads evenly rather than taking just the first N', () => {
    const files = Array.from({ length: 1000 }, (_, i) => xmlFile(`${i}.xml`, '<a/>'))
    const sampled = smartSample(files, 200)
    expect(sampled).toHaveLength(200)
    // An even spread should include files from near the end, not just indices 0-199.
    const indices = sampled.map((f) => Number(f.name.replace('.xml', '')))
    expect(Math.max(...indices)).toBeGreaterThan(900)
  })
})

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/lib/browserXmlGrouper.ts ===
/**
 * Groups a folder of sample XMLs by root element + namespace (or a structure fingerprint when
 * there's no namespace) entirely in the browser, before anything is uploaded -- so a user who
 * picks a folder with 50,000 files only ever sends the server a representative sample (C2).
 * Mirrors the server-side FileGrouper's logic exactly (same key scheme), just running on
 * File/DOMParser instead of Path/StAX.
 */

export interface BrowserFileGroup {
  groupKey: string
  namespace: string
  rootElementName: string
  fingerprint: string | null
  files: File[]
}

export interface BrowserGroupResult {
  groups: BrowserFileGroup[]
  brokenFiles: File[]
}

export async function groupFilesInBrowser(files: File[]): Promise<BrowserGroupResult> {
  const byKey = new Map<string, BrowserFileGroup>()
  const broken: File[] = []

  for (const file of files) {
    try {
      const peek = await peekRoot(file)
      const key = peek.namespace ? `${peek.namespace}:${peek.rootName}` : `${peek.rootName}#${peek.fingerprint}`
      let group = byKey.get(key)
      if (!group) {
        group = {
          groupKey: key,
          namespace: peek.namespace,
          rootElementName: peek.rootName,
          fingerprint: peek.namespace ? null : peek.fingerprint,
          files: [],
        }
        byKey.set(key, group)
      }
      group.files.push(file)
    } catch {
      broken.push(file)
    }
  }

  return { groups: Array.from(byKey.values()), brokenFiles: broken }
}

async function peekRoot(file: File): Promise<{ namespace: string; rootName: string; fingerprint: string }> {
  const text = await file.text()
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, 'application/xml')
  if (doc.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length > 0) {
    throw new Error(`${file.name} is not well-formed XML`)
  }
  const root = doc.documentElement
  if (!root) {
    throw new Error(`${file.name} has no root element`)
  }
  const childNames = new Set<string>()
  for (const child of Array.from(root.children)) {
    childNames.add(child.localName)
  }
  return {
    namespace: root.namespaceURI ?? '',
    rootName: root.localName,
    fingerprint: Array.from(childNames).sort().join(','),
  }
}

/** Evenly-spaced sample across the whole list (not just the first N) so the sample isn't biased
 * toward whatever a directory listing happened to return first. */
export function smartSample(files: File[], maxSamples = 200): File[] {
  if (files.length <= maxSamples) {
    return files
  }
  const step = files.length / maxSamples
  const sampled: File[] = []
  for (let i = 0; i < maxSamples; i++) {
    sampled.push(files[Math.floor(i * step)])
  }
  return sampled
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/lib/readFirstZipEntry.test.ts ===
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { readFirstZipEntry } from './readFirstZipEntry'

// TS's typed-array generics (Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>) are stricter than lib.dom's BlobPart
// (which wants ArrayBufferView<ArrayBuffer> specifically) even though a Uint8Array has always
// been a valid Blob part at runtime -- a type-level-only mismatch, not a behavior change.
function asBlobPart(bytes: Uint8Array): BlobPart {
  return bytes as unknown as BlobPart
}

function crc32(buf: Uint8Array): number {
  const table: number[] = []
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    let c = n
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1
    }
    table[n] = c >>> 0
  }
  let crc = 0xffffffff
  for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
    crc = table[(crc ^ buf[i]) & 0xff] ^ (crc >>> 8)
  }
  return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0
}

async function deflateRaw(data: Uint8Array): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const stream = new Blob([asBlobPart(data)]).stream().pipeThrough(new CompressionStream('deflate-raw'))
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer())
}

function concat(parts: Uint8Array[]): Uint8Array {
  const out = new Uint8Array(parts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.length, 0))
  let offset = 0
  for (const p of parts) {
    out.set(p, offset)
    offset += p.length
  }
  return out
}

function u16(view: DataView, offset: number, value: number) {
  view.setUint16(offset, value, true)
}

function u32(view: DataView, offset: number, value: number) {
  view.setUint32(offset, value, true)
}

/** Builds a single-entry ZIP using the same "streaming / data descriptor" format Java's
 * ZipOutputStream writes for deflate entries by default: the local file header's CRC/compressed
 * size/uncompressed size fields are left at 0 (deferred to a data descriptor written after the
 * entry's data), with the real sizes only present in the central directory at the end. */
async function buildStreamingFormatZip(fileName: string, content: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const nameBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(fileName)
  const uncompressed = new TextEncoder().encode(content)
  const compressed = await deflateRaw(uncompressed)
  const crc = crc32(uncompressed)

  const localHeader = new Uint8Array(30)
  const lv = new DataView(localHeader.buffer)
  u32(lv, 0, 0x04034b50)
  u16(lv, 4, 20)
  u16(lv, 6, 0x0008) // general purpose flag: bit 3 = data descriptor used
  u16(lv, 8, 8) // compression method: deflate
  u16(lv, 10, 0)
  u16(lv, 12, 0)
  u32(lv, 14, 0) // crc-32 -- deferred, 0 here (reproduces the real bug input)
  u32(lv, 18, 0) // compressed size -- deferred, 0 here
  u32(lv, 22, 0) // uncompressed size -- deferred, 0 here
  u16(lv, 26, nameBytes.length)
  u16(lv, 28, 0)

  const dataDescriptor = new Uint8Array(16)
  const dv = new DataView(dataDescriptor.buffer)
  u32(dv, 0, 0x08074b50)
  u32(dv, 4, crc)
  u32(dv, 8, compressed.length)
  u32(dv, 12, uncompressed.length)

  const localSection = concat([localHeader, nameBytes, compressed, dataDescriptor])
  const centralDirOffset = localSection.length

  const centralHeader = new Uint8Array(46)
  const cv = new DataView(centralHeader.buffer)
  u32(cv, 0, 0x02014b50)
  u16(cv, 4, 20)
  u16(cv, 6, 20)
  u16(cv, 8, 0x0008)
  u16(cv, 10, 8)
  u16(cv, 12, 0)
  u16(cv, 14, 0)
  u32(cv, 16, crc)
  u32(cv, 20, compressed.length) // the real size -- only here, not in the local header
  u32(cv, 24, uncompressed.length)
  u16(cv, 28, nameBytes.length)
  u16(cv, 30, 0)
  u16(cv, 32, 0)
  u16(cv, 34, 0)
  u16(cv, 36, 0)
  u32(cv, 38, 0)
  u32(cv, 42, 0) // local header offset

  const centralSection = concat([centralHeader, nameBytes])
  const centralDirSize = centralSection.length

  const eocd = new Uint8Array(22)
  const ev = new DataView(eocd.buffer)
  u32(ev, 0, 0x06054b50)
  u16(ev, 4, 0)
  u16(ev, 6, 0)
  u16(ev, 8, 1)
  u16(ev, 10, 1)
  u32(ev, 12, centralDirSize)
  u32(ev, 16, centralDirOffset)
  u16(ev, 20, 0)

  return concat([localSection, centralSection, eocd])
}

describe('readFirstZipEntry', () => {
  it("reads a deflate entry even when the local header's size/CRC are 0 (ZipOutputStream's streaming format)", async () => {
    const xml = '<?xml version="1.0"?><root><value>hello</value></root>'
    const zipBytes = await buildStreamingFormatZip('Document_small_1.xml', xml)
    const text = await readFirstZipEntry(new Blob([asBlobPart(zipBytes)]))
    expect(text).toBe(xml)
  })

  it('throws a clear error when no .xml entry is present', async () => {
    const zipBytes = await buildStreamingFormatZip('report.json', '{}')
    await expect(readFirstZipEntry(new Blob([asBlobPart(zipBytes)]))).rejects.toThrow('No .xml entry found')
  })
})

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/lib/readFirstZipEntry.ts ===
/**
 * Pulls the first .xml entry out of a ZIP blob, for the Generate page's live preview -- just
 * enough of the ZIP format to read one small entry, using the browser's built-in
 * DecompressionStream for "deflate" entries so no zip library is needed.
 *
 * Reads entry metadata from the central directory (at the end of the archive), not from each
 * entry's own local file header: Java's ZipOutputStream writes deflate entries in the streaming
 * "data descriptor" format (general-purpose flag bit 3), which leaves the local header's
 * compressed/uncompressed size and CRC-32 fields as 0 -- the real values are deferred to a
 * descriptor written after the entry's data. The central directory always has the real sizes
 * regardless of which format the local headers use, which is exactly why standard zip tools
 * (and the JDK's own ZipFile) read it instead of walking local headers directly.
 */
export async function readFirstZipEntry(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer())
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer)

  const EOCD_SIGNATURE = 0x06054b50
  const CENTRAL_DIR_SIGNATURE = 0x02014b50
  // The EOCD record is 22 bytes plus an optional comment (up to 65535 bytes) -- scan backward
  // from the end for its signature rather than assuming a fixed offset.
  const searchStart = Math.max(0, bytes.length - 22 - 65557)
  let eocdOffset = -1
  for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= searchStart; i--) {
    if (view.getUint32(i, true) === EOCD_SIGNATURE) {
      eocdOffset = i
      break
    }
  }
  if (eocdOffset < 0) {
    throw new Error('Not a valid zip file (no end-of-central-directory record found)')
  }

  const totalEntries = view.getUint16(eocdOffset + 10, true)
  let cdOffset = view.getUint32(eocdOffset + 16, true)

  for (let i = 0; i < totalEntries; i++) {
    if (view.getUint32(cdOffset, true) !== CENTRAL_DIR_SIGNATURE) {
      break
    }
    const compressionMethod = view.getUint16(cdOffset + 10, true)
    const compressedSize = view.getUint32(cdOffset + 20, true)
    const fileNameLength = view.getUint16(cdOffset + 28, true)
    const extraLength = view.getUint16(cdOffset + 30, true)
    const commentLength = view.getUint16(cdOffset + 32, true)
    const localHeaderOffset = view.getUint32(cdOffset + 42, true)
    const name = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes.subarray(cdOffset + 46, cdOffset + 46 + fileNameLength))

    if (name.endsWith('.xml')) {
      // The local header's own filename/extra-length fields are reliable even in streaming
      // mode -- only its size/CRC fields are the ones deferred -- so they're used just to find
      // where this entry's data actually starts; the central directory's size says how much of it to read.
      const localFileNameLength = view.getUint16(localHeaderOffset + 26, true)
      const localExtraLength = view.getUint16(localHeaderOffset + 28, true)
      const dataStart = localHeaderOffset + 30 + localFileNameLength + localExtraLength
      const raw = bytes.subarray(dataStart, dataStart + compressedSize)

      if (compressionMethod === 0) {
        return new TextDecoder().decode(raw)
      }
      if (compressionMethod === 8) {
        const stream = new Blob([raw]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'))
        const decompressed = await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer()
        return new TextDecoder().decode(decompressed)
      }
      throw new Error(`Unsupported zip compression method: ${compressionMethod}`)
    }

    cdOffset += 46 + fileNameLength + extraLength + commentLength
  }
  throw new Error('No .xml entry found in zip')
}

@@@=== FILE START: xml-toolkit-ui/src/lib/useJob.ts ===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import type { JobStatus } from '../api/types'

export interface JobState {
  status: JobStatus | null
  progressPercent: number
  errorMessage: string
}

/** Tracks one job's live status via SSE (GET /api/jobs/{id}/events); falls back to polling if
 * the stream errors out (e.g. a proxy that buffers/doesn't support it), so the UI never just
 * stalls silently. */
export function useJob(jobId: string | null): JobState {
  const [state, setState] = useState<JobState>({ status: null, progressPercent: 0, errorMessage: '' })
  const pollRef = useRef<number | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId) {
      setState({ status: null, progressPercent: 0, errorMessage: '' })
      return
    }

    let stopped = false
    const applyStatus = (data: { status: JobStatus; progressPercent: number; errorMessage?: string }) => {
      if (stopped) return
      setState({ status: data.status, progressPercent: data.progressPercent, errorMessage: data.errorMessage ?? '' })
    }

    const startPolling = () => {
      if (pollRef.current) return
      pollRef.current = window.setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const s = await api.jobStatus(jobId)
          applyStatus(s)
          if (s.status === 'SUCCEEDED' || s.status === 'FAILED' || s.status === 'CANCELLED') {
            stopPolling()
          }
        } catch {
          // keep trying; a transient network blip shouldn't kill progress tracking
        }
      }, 1000)
    }
    const stopPolling = () => {
      if (pollRef.current) {
        window.clearInterval(pollRef.current)
        pollRef.current = null
      }
    }

    const source = new EventSource(api.jobEventsUrl(jobId))
    source.onmessage = (ev) => {
      try {
        applyStatus(JSON.parse(ev.data))
      } catch {
        // ignore a malformed event rather than crash the whole tracker
      }
    }
    source.onerror = () => {
      source.close()
      startPolling()
    }

    return () => {
      stopped = true
      source.close()
      stopPolling()
    }
  }, [jobId])

  return state
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import { useJob } from '../lib/useJob'

import FileDropzone from '../components/ui/FileDropzone'
import SearchableSelect, { type SelectOption } from '../components/ui/SearchableSelect'
import type { FileGroup, ReviewItem, SchemaRecord } from '../api/types'

type InputMode = 'folder' | 'zip' | 'serverPath'

const MAX_SAMPLES_DEFAULT = 200

const SOURCE_CARDS: { mode: InputMode; title: string; desc: string; icon: JSX.Element }[] = [
  {
    mode: 'folder',
    title: 'Local Folder',
    desc: 'Pick XML files or a whole folder from this computer.',
    icon: (
      <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
        <path d="M3 7a2 2 0 012-2h4l2 2h8a2 2 0 012 2v9a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V7z" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinejoin="round" />

        <path d="M4 4h16v16H4V4z" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinejoin="round" />

export default function CreateXsdPage() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<InputMode>('folder')
  const [xmlFiles, setXmlFiles] = useState<File[]>([])
  const [browserGroups, setBrowserGroups] = useState<BrowserFileGroup[]>([])
  const [browserBroken, setBrowserBroken] = useState<File[]>([])
  const [selectedGroups, setSelectedGroups] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set())
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false)

  const [zipFiles, setZipFiles] = useState<File[]>([])
  const [serverPath, setServerPath] = useState('')

  const [schemas, setSchemas] = useState<SchemaRecord[]>([])
  const [baselineSchemaId, setBaselineSchemaId] = useState('')
  const [baselineUploading, setBaselineUploading] = useState(false)
  const [baselineError, setBaselineError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  const [jobId, setJobId] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const job = useJob(jobId)

  const [serverGroups, setServerGroups] = useState<FileGroup[]>([])
  const [brokenFiles, setBrokenFiles] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [activeGroup, setActiveGroup] = useState('')
  const [review, setReview] = useState<ReviewItem[]>([])
  const [decisions, setDecisions] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [rebuildResult, setRebuildResult] = useState<{ validSamples: number; totalSamples: number; note: string } | null>(null)
  const [registered, setRegistered] = useState<Record<string, SchemaRecord>>({})
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    api.listSchemas().then(setSchemas).catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (job.status === 'SUCCEEDED' && jobId) {
      api.inferGroups(jobId).then((g) => {
        setServerGroups(g.groups)
        setBrokenFiles(g.brokenFiles)
        if (g.groups.length > 0) setActiveGroup(g.groups[0].groupKey)
      })
    }
  }, [job.status, jobId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (jobId && activeGroup && job.status === 'SUCCEEDED') {
      loadReview()
    }
  }, [jobId, activeGroup, job.status])

  async function loadReview() {
    if (!jobId || !activeGroup) return
    const r = await api.inferReview(jobId, activeGroup)
    setReview(r.needsReview)
    setRebuildResult(null)
  }

  async function handleXmlFilesChange(files: File[]) {
    setXmlFiles(files)
    if (files.length === 0) {
      setBrowserGroups([])
      setBrowserBroken([])
      setSelectedGroups(new Set())
      return
    }
    setScanning(true)
    setSubmitError(null)
    try {
      const { groups, brokenFiles: broken } = await groupFilesInBrowser(files)
      setBrowserGroups(groups)
      setBrowserBroken(broken)
      setSelectedGroups(new Set(groups.map((g) => g.groupKey)))
    } catch (e) {
      setSubmitError(String(e))
    } finally {
      setScanning(false)
    }
  }

  function toggleGroup(key: string) {
    setSelectedGroups((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev)
      if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key)
      else next.add(key)
      return next
    })
  }

  const toUploadCount = browserGroups
    .filter((g) => selectedGroups.has(g.groupKey))
    .reduce((sum, g) => sum + Math.min(g.files.length, MAX_SAMPLES_DEFAULT), 0)

  async function handleCreateXsd() {
    setSubmitting(true)
    setSubmitError(null)
    setServerGroups([])
    setReview([])
    setRebuildResult(null)
    setRegistered({})
    try {
      const opts = baselineSchemaId ? { baselineSchemaId } : {}
      let result: { jobId: string }
      if (mode === 'folder') {
        const sampledFiles = browserGroups
          .filter((g) => selectedGroups.has(g.groupKey))
          .flatMap((g) => smartSample(g.files, MAX_SAMPLES_DEFAULT))
        if (sampledFiles.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('Choose XML files (or a folder) and select at least one group first.')
        }
        result = await api.inferFromFiles(sampledFiles, opts)
      } else if (mode === 'zip') {
        if (zipFiles.length === 0) throw new Error('Choose a ZIP file first.')
        result = await api.inferFromZip(zipFiles[0], { ...opts, maxSamples: MAX_SAMPLES_DEFAULT })
      } else {
        if (!serverPath.trim()) throw new Error('Enter a server path first.')
        result = await api.inferFromServerPath(serverPath.trim(), { ...opts, maxSamples: MAX_SAMPLES_DEFAULT })
      }
      setJobId(result.jobId)
    } catch (e) {
      setSubmitError(String(e))
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false)
    }
  }

  async function handleBaselineUpload(file: File) {
    setBaselineUploading(true)
    setBaselineError(null)
    try {
      const record = await api.uploadSchema(file)
      setSchemas((prev) => [...prev, record])
      setBaselineSchemaId(record.id)
    } catch (e) {
      setBaselineError(String(e))
    } finally {
      setBaselineUploading(false)
    }
  }

  function acceptAll() {
    const next = { ...decisions }
    review.forEach((item) => {
      next[item.path] = 'accept'
    })
    setDecisions(next)
  }

  async function handleRebuild() {
    if (!jobId || !activeGroup) return
    setActionError(null)
    try {
      const result = await api.inferDecisions(jobId, activeGroup, decisions)
      setRebuildResult(result)
      await loadReview()
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(String(e))
    }
  }

  async function handleRegister() {
    if (!jobId || !activeGroup) return
    setActionError(null)
    try {
      const record = await api.inferRegister(jobId, activeGroup)
      setRegistered((prev) => ({ ...prev, [activeGroup]: record }))
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(String(e))
    }
  }

  function downloadReview() {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(review, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const a = document.createElement('a')
    a.href = url
    a.download = 'review.json'
    a.click()
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
  }

  const isRunning = job.status === 'PENDING' || job.status === 'RUNNING'
  const currentGroupInfo = serverGroups.find((g) => g.groupKey === activeGroup)

  const baselineOptions: SelectOption[] = schemas.map((s) => ({
    value: s.id,
    label: s.name,
    description: s.version ? `version ${s.version}` : undefined,
  }))

  const canSubmit = mode === 'folder' ? xmlFiles.length > 0 : mode === 'zip' ? zipFiles.length > 0 : serverPath.trim().length > 0

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Create XSD</h1>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="section-title">XML Source</div>
        <div className="section-desc">Where should the sample XMLs come from?</div>
        <div className="card-select-row">
          {SOURCE_CARDS.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.mode}
              type="button"
              className={`card-select${mode === c.mode ? ' card-selected' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setMode(c.mode)}
            >
              <span className="card-select-icon">{c.icon}</span>
              <span className="card-select-title">{c.title}</span>
              <span className="card-select-desc">{c.desc}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {mode === 'folder' && (

            {browserGroups.length > 0 && (
              <div className="muted" style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>

                {MAX_SAMPLES_DEFAULT} per group).
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

        {mode === 'zip' && (

            <FileDropzone
              files={zipFiles}
              onFilesChange={setZipFiles}
